items.title: 〈台泥拓展東歐市場〉擬以212億元企業價值 併購烏克蘭第二大水泥公司
items.title_en: Taiwan Cement Expands into Eastern Europe with a 21.2‑Billion‑NTD Valuation to Acquire Ukraine's Second‑Largest Cement Company
paras: 台泥(1101-TW)今(23)日召開重大訊息記者會，臨時董事會通過授權集團旗下荷蘭子公司TCC Group EMEA Holdings B.V.，以不超過7.5億歐元、約新台幣212億元的企業價值，收購烏克蘭水泥建材公司Ivano-Frankivskcement（IFCEM）等公司100%股權，進一步將歐洲水泥版圖由南歐、西歐延伸至東歐。
IFCEM為烏克蘭第二大水泥公司，正式員工超過2,500人，市占率約36%，公司建材年產能約400萬噸，2025年水泥營收占比約95%。除水泥外，事業範圍還涵蓋預拌混凝土、骨材、屋頂建材、石膏製品及乾混砂漿，台泥此次收購範圍除IFCEM及其子公司外，也包括屋頂建材公司Ivano-Frankivsk-Dakh、石膏製品公司KRU Gips與乾混砂漿公司KRU Mix。
另根據IFCEM網路上公開年報，2025年營收年增20.3%，毛利64.42億格里夫納、年增40.3%，毛利率39.6%，較2024年增加5.6個百分點；營業利益53.77億格里夫納，年增51.2%，稅後淨利則年增44.5%，淨利率約26.4%；EBITDA為64.73億格里夫納，年增46.2%，EBITDA率39.8%，顯示公司在戰爭期間仍維持生產及獲利能力。
台泥指出，IFCEM具備銷售至鄰近東歐國家的業務網絡，出口市場以波蘭、羅馬尼亞為主，另供應摩爾多瓦、斯洛伐克與匈牙利；若本案完成，台泥將把集團在低碳研發與生產等領域的經驗導入IFCEM，進一步拓展東歐市場。
台泥指出，此次收購標的將直屬台泥荷蘭控股公司，不會納入預計於歐洲上市的Cimpor International架構之下，也保留引進國際金融機構共同投資人的彈性，目前已有超國家金融基金（Supranational Funds）表達投資意願。
台泥表示，本案委請Morgan Stanley擔任評價財務顧問，並由國際法律、財務會計、稅務及環境顧問進行盡職調查，針對制裁、勞動力、營運及外匯管制等風險逐項檢視，實際交易金額將於交割時，依淨負債及淨營運資金等項目調整。本交易尚須取得台灣、烏克蘭等多地主管機關核准後，方能完成交割。
paras_en: Taiwan Cement (1101‑TW) held a major news conference today (the 23rd), where an emergency board authorized its Dutch subsidiary TCC Group EMEA Holdings B.V. to acquire 100% of Ukrainian cement and building materials company Ivano‑Frankivskcement (IFCEM) and related entities for up to €750 million, roughly NT$212 billion in enterprise value, extending the group’s European cement footprint from Southern and Western Europe into Eastern Europe.

IFCEM is Ukraine’s second‑largest cement producer, employing more than 2,500 staff and holding about a 36% market share. The company’s annual building‑materials capacity is around 4 million tonnes, with cement accounting for roughly 95% of its 2025 revenue. In addition to cement, its business includes ready‑mix concrete, aggregates, roofing materials, gypsum products and dry‑mix mortar. The Taiwan Cement acquisition covers IFCEM and its subsidiaries as well as roofing‑materials firm Ivano‑Frankivsk‑Dakh, gypsum‑product company KRU Gips and dry‑mix mortar company KRU Mix.

According to IFCEM’s publicly posted annual report, 2025 revenue is projected to grow 20.3% year‑on‑year, with gross profit of UAH 6.442 billion—a 40.3% increase—and a gross margin of 39.6%, up 5.6 percentage points from 2024. Operating profit is expected at UAH 5.377 billion, up 51.2%, while after‑tax net profit should rise 44.5% to a net margin of about 26.4%. EBITDA is forecast at UAH 6.473 billion, a 46.2% rise, giving an EBITDA margin of 39.8%, indicating the company has maintained production and profitability despite the war.

Taiwan Cement noted that IFCEM has a sales network reaching neighboring Eastern‑European countries, with exports mainly to Poland and Romania and supplies also to Moldova, Slovakia and Hungary. If the deal closes, Taiwan Cement will bring its low‑carbon R&D and production expertise to IFCEM, further expanding its presence in the Eastern‑European market.

Taiwan Cement said the acquisition target will be directly owned by its Dutch holding company and will not be placed under the Cimpor International structure that is planned for a future European listing. The deal retains flexibility to bring in international financial institutions as co‑investors, and supranational funds have already expressed interest.

Taiwan Cement disclosed that Morgan Stanley has been engaged as valuation and financial adviser, with international legal, accounting, tax and environmental advisors conducting due diligence. Risks related to sanctions, labor, operations and foreign‑exchange controls are being examined item by item, and the final transaction price will be adjusted at closing for net debt and net working capital. The transaction still requires approvals from regulators in Taiwan, Ukraine and other jurisdictions before it can be completed.

items.title: NAND不再只是儲存商品 SanDisk目標價喊到2400美元、還能漲30％
items.title_en: NAND Is No Longer Just a Storage Commodity – SanDisk’s Target Price Hits $2,400, Still Up 30%
paras: 在人工智慧（AI）帶動記憶體與儲存需求激增下，SanDisk(SNDKV-US) 股價今年大幅飆升。隨著相關技術快速發展，分析師認為，該公司的業務定位正迎來轉變。
SanDisk 的 NAND 快閃記憶體過去通常被視為大宗儲存產品，但 Rosenblatt 分析師凱西迪（Kevin Cassidy）在最新報告中指出，新一代 AI 系統正為 NAND 創造重新定位的機會，使其從一般儲存產品轉變為 AI 基礎設施中更關鍵的系統元件。
凱西迪也首次將 SanDisk 納入追蹤研究，給予買進評等。NAND 快閃記憶體屬於非揮發性記憶體，這意味著它能在無須持續供電的情況下保存資料。
凱西迪表示，過去個人電腦、智慧手機及其他消費電子產品對 NAND 的需求，主要由儲存密度提升與每位元成本下降所驅動。
儲存密度是指 NAND 快閃記憶體在一定實體空間內可容納的資料量，每位元成本則是 NAND 記憶單元儲存每單位資料的成本。
不過，隨著 AI 模型規模擴大，加上推論程序需要處理大量資料，市場考量正從追求最低絕對價格，逐漸轉向更重視儲存密度、效能、耐用度及供應穩定性。所謂推論，是指 AI 模型依據已學習的模式進行預測。
SanDisk 的技術藍圖涵蓋與日本鎧俠（Kioxia）共同開發的 BiCS8 與 BiCS10 架構，透過垂直堆疊記憶體單元，在更小的空間內實現更高儲存容量，這項優勢完美呼應了凱西迪所看好的願景，將使 NAND 「進一步提升其對整體 AI 系統的價值」。
在凱西迪看來，SanDisk 的 NAND 快閃記憶體技術能在合適的成本下實現更高密度，這將有助於其在大型 AI 儲存產品領域中，「維持效能與成本的雙重優勢」。
他預估，SanDisk 於 6 月底展開的 2027 會計年度，資料中心整體營收將達 217 億美元，並在 2028 會計年度進一步增至 286 億美元。
凱西迪給予 SanDisk 目標價 2,400 美元，較該股周二早盤的 1,849.75 美元仍有約 30% 上漲空間。
此外，凱西迪也提到 SanDisk 新推出的商業模式協議，目前已與八家主要 NAND 客戶達成合作。隨著 AI 需求持續造成 NAND 供應短缺，這類多年期合約可讓客戶依特定價格確保供貨。
這些協議將涵蓋 SanDisk 大部分 NAND 產能。凱西迪表示，此舉可望提高需求能見度，並降低 NAND 產業過往常見的景氣循環波動。
paras_en: Amid the AI‑driven surge in memory and storage demand, SanDisk (SNDKV‑US) shares have rocketed this year. As related technologies evolve rapidly, analysts say the company’s business positioning is undergoing a shift.

SanDisk’s NAND flash memory has traditionally been viewed as a bulk storage product, but Rosenblatt analyst Kevin Cassidy noted in his latest report that new‑generation AI systems are creating an opportunity to reposition NAND, turning it from a generic storage item into a more critical component of AI infrastructure.
Cassidy also added SanDisk to his coverage for the first time, assigning a buy rating. NAND flash is a type of non‑volatile memory, meaning it can retain data without continuous power.
He explained that past demand for NAND from PCs, smartphones and other consumer electronics was driven mainly by higher storage density and lower cost per bit.
Storage density refers to the amount of data NAND flash can hold within a given physical space, while cost per bit is the expense of storing each unit of data in a NAND cell.

However, as AI model sizes grow and inference workloads require processing massive data volumes, the market is shifting from chasing the lowest absolute price to placing greater emphasis on density, performance, durability and supply stability. Inference means an AI model makes predictions based on patterns it has learned.

SanDisk’s technology roadmap includes the BiCS8 and BiCS10 architectures co‑developed with Japan’s Kioxia, which stack memory cells vertically to achieve higher capacity in a smaller footprint—an advantage that aligns perfectly with Cassidy’s vision of further enhancing NAND’s value to overall AI systems.
According to Cassidy, SanDisk’s NAND flash can deliver higher density at an acceptable cost, helping it maintain both performance and cost advantages in the large‑scale AI storage market.
He projects that for the fiscal year ending June 30, 2027, SanDisk’s data‑center revenue will reach $21.7 billion, rising to $28.6 billion in fiscal 2028.
Cassidy set a target price of $2,400 for SanDisk, roughly a 30% upside from the stock’s early‑day price of $1,849.75 on Tuesday.

He also noted that SanDisk has recently launched a commercial‑model agreement, already securing deals with eight major NAND customers. As AI demand continues to tighten NAND supply, these multi‑year contracts let customers lock in supply at predetermined prices.
These agreements will cover most of SanDisk’s NAND capacity. Cassidy said the move should improve demand visibility and dampen the cyclical volatility that has historically plagued the NAND industry.

items.title: OpenAI擴大GPT-6產品線 Sol、Luna雙雙降價50%
items.title_en: OpenAI Expands GPT-6 Lineup, Sol and Luna Both Cut Prices by 50%
paras: OpenAI 週二 (22 日) 推出 GPT-6 Sol 與 GPT-6 Luna，進一步擴充 GPT-6 產品線。兩款模型承襲旗艦模型 GPT-6 Astra 的部分能力，API 價格則較 GPT-5.6 Sol 與 Luna 的促銷價降低 50%。
在 GPT-6 系列中，Astra 仍是 OpenAI 處理高難度專案時能力最完整的模型；Sol 與 Luna 則以較低成本滿足不同工作需求。
GPT-6 Sol 主要用於程式設計、工作流程自動化及其他複雜的專業任務；GPT-6 Luna 則適合文件摘要、資訊擷取等工作量大、重複性高且目標明確的任務。
OpenAI 表示，Sol 與 Luna 採用與 Astra 類似的方法訓練，因此承襲 Astra 在推理、事實準確度、程式設計、電腦操作及對齊能力方面的部分進展。
價格方面，GPT-6 Sol 每 100 萬個輸入 token 收費 2 美元，每 100 萬個輸出 token 收費 10 美元，較 GPT-5.6 Sol 的促銷價降低 50%。GPT-6 Luna 每 100 萬個輸入 token 收費 0.1 美元，每 100 萬個輸出 token 收費 0.5 美元，同樣較前一代促銷價減半。
OpenAI 將降價歸因於快取與推論效率提升。GPT-6 可提高提示快取命中率，讓 AI 代理重複利用更多既有內容，縮短回應時間；讀取已快取的輸入 token 時，價格折扣最高可達 90%。
效能方面，GPT-6 Sol 在 AutomationBench 工作流程測試中，以高推理強度執行任務時，表現超越採用最高推理強度的 Claude Opus 5，每項任務成本則僅相當於後者的 9%。
OpenAI 也表示，在根據使用者回報錯誤所進行的事實準確度測試中，GPT-6 Sol 的錯誤數量約為上一代的一半，並在 DeepSWE v1.1 軟體工程基準測試及電腦操作任務中展現更佳表現。
此外，OpenAI 將 Astra 的溝通風格導入 Sol 與 Luna，使兩款模型在技術及程式設計對話中提供更清楚、精簡的回答，並減少術語、不自然措辭及價值較低的細節。兩款模型在對齊測試中，提出誤導性說法的比率也低於 GPT-5.6 系列。
GPT-6 Sol 與 Luna 現已開放 ChatGPT Work 及 Codex 的 Plus、Pro、Business、Enterprise 與 Education 用戶使用；Free 和 Go 用戶可透過桌面版應用程式使用 GPT-6 Luna。兩款模型尚未全面開放一般 ChatGPT 對話使用，OpenAI 將分階段部署，以維持服務穩定。
值得注意的是，OpenAI 此前曾警告，Astra 有時可能嘗試規避人類監督。隨著旗下 AI 代理曾發生進入其他企業系統的事件，外界對先進 AI 模型行為的檢視也持續升高。
GPT-6 Sol 與 Luna 發布前約 90 分鐘，Anthropic 才推出 Claude Opus 5.5，凸顯兩家公司在模型效能與使用成本方面的競爭。
paras_en: OpenAI on Tuesday (the 22nd) launched GPT-6 Sol and GPT-6 Luna, further expanding the GPT-6 product line. Both models inherit some capabilities of the flagship GPT-6 Astra and are priced at 50% lower than the promotional rates for GPT-5.6 Sol and Luna.
Within the GPT-6 series, Astra remains OpenAI’s most capable model for handling high‑difficulty projects, while Sol and Luna provide lower‑cost options for different work needs.

GPT-6 Sol is primarily aimed at programming, workflow automation and other complex professional tasks; GPT-6 Luna is suited for large‑scale, repetitive, well‑defined tasks such as document summarization and information extraction.
OpenAI says Sol and Luna are trained with methods similar to Astra, thus inheriting some of Astra’s advances in reasoning, factual accuracy, coding, computer operation and alignment capabilities.

Pricing: GPT-6 Sol costs $2 per million input tokens and $10 per million output tokens, a 50% reduction from GPT-5.6 Sol’s promotional price. GPT-6 Luna costs $0.1 per million input tokens and $0.5 per million output tokens, also half of the previous generation’s promotional rates.

OpenAI attributes the price cuts to improvements in caching and inference efficiency. GPT-6 can increase prompt‑cache hit rates, allowing AI agents to reuse more existing content and shorten response times; when reading cached input tokens, discounts can reach up to 90%.
In performance tests, GPT-6 Sol outperformed Claude Opus 5 running at the highest inference intensity on the AutomationBench workflow benchmark, with each task costing only about 9% of Claude’s cost.

OpenAI also reports that in factual‑accuracy tests based on user‑reported errors, GPT-6 Sol produced roughly half the errors of the prior generation, and showed better results on the DeepSWE v1.1 software‑engineering benchmark and computer‑operation tasks.

Furthermore, OpenAI has infused Astra’s communication style into Sol and Luna, making the two models give clearer, more concise answers in technical and coding dialogues while reducing jargon, unnatural phrasing and low‑value details. In alignment tests, the rate of misleading statements is lower than in the GPT‑5.6 series.

GPT-6 Sol and Luna are now available to ChatGPT Work and Codex Plus, Pro, Business, Enterprise and Education users; Free and Go users can access GPT-6 Luna via the desktop app. The models are not yet fully open for general ChatGPT conversations, with OpenAI rolling them out in stages to maintain service stability.

It is worth noting that OpenAI previously warned that Astra can sometimes attempt to evade human oversight. As AI agents from the company have previously entered other companies’ systems, external scrutiny of advanced AI model behavior remains heightened.
About 90 minutes before the GPT‑6 Sol and Luna release, Anthropic launched Claude Opus 5.5, highlighting the competition between the two firms on model performance and usage cost.

items.title: 思科跌逾4% Piper Sandler下調目標價 憂成長見頂
items.title_en: Cisco Falls Over 4% as Piper Sandler Cuts Target Price, Concern Growth Peaked
paras: 《CNBC》報導，思科(Cisco)(CSCO-US)股價周二(22日)下跌4.5%，因投行Piper Sandler將這家網路設備供應商的目標價從132美元下調至125美元。
Piper Sandler分析師表示，由於市場擔憂產業成長可能已接近高峰，因此下調對本益比倍數的預期。
思科股價在6月創下歷史新高，過去12個月累計上漲57%，營收也隨著人工智慧熱潮大幅成長。該股周二收在106.44美元。
思科上個月公布強勁的第四季財報，營收達172.5億美元，高於LSEG預估的168億美元，財報表現優於市場預期。
思科在8月最新一次財報電話會議上，針對2027會計年度發布強勁財測，但由於分析師反應冷淡，股價隨後下跌。
思科預估營收將成長近15%，但分析師認為，營收成長率將回落至個位數。Piper Sandler分析師則認為，在市場需求更加強勁的背景下，思科這項預測顯得「保守」。
思科執行長Chuck Robbins上個月受訪時表示，「我們正開始新的一個會計年度。我們正處於非常強勁的市場之中。但這同時是我們將以稍微更加審慎的態度開始新年度的時期。」
超大規模雲端服務商(hyperscaler)在2026會計年度貢獻約40億美元營收，而思科預期這項數字在2027年度將接近翻倍，達到75億美元。
paras_en: CNBC reported that Cisco (CSCO-US) shares fell 4.5% on Tuesday the 22nd after investment bank Piper Sandler lowered the network‑equipment maker’s price target from $132 to $125.
Piper Sandler analysts said the target‑price cut reflects market worries that industry growth may be nearing its peak, prompting a downgrade of the expected price‑to‑earnings multiple.
Cisco’s stock hit an all‑time high in June and has risen 57% over the past 12 months, with revenue surging alongside the AI boom. The shares closed Tuesday at $106.44.
The company posted a strong fourth‑quarter earnings report last month, with revenue of $17.25 billion, beating LSEG’s estimate of $16.8 billion and exceeding market expectations.
In the most recent earnings call in August, Cisco presented a robust outlook for fiscal 2027, but tepid analyst reaction sent the stock lower afterward.

Cisco forecasts revenue growth of nearly 15%, though analysts expect the growth rate to fall back into single‑digit territory. Piper Sandler’s analysts argue that, given stronger market demand, Cisco’s guidance appears "conservative."

CEO Chuck Robbins said in an interview last month, "We are starting a new fiscal year. We are in a very strong market, but it is also a time when we will begin the new year with a slightly more cautious approach."
Hyperscale cloud providers generated about $4 billion of revenue for Cisco in fiscal 2026, and the company expects that figure to almost double to $7.5 billion in fiscal 2027.

items.title: 〈貴金屬盤後〉市場強化Fed升息預期 黃金再度下挫
items.title_en: Gold Falls Again as Market Strengthens Fed Rate‑Hike Expectations
paras: 黃金周二(22日)再度走低，市場強化對聯準會(Fed)採取限制性貨幣政策的立場，而交易員也密切關注中東衝突發展。

黃金現貨下跌0.2%，報每盎司4336.21美元。
美國黃金期貨收低0.2%，報每盎司4376.40美元。


美元兌六種主要貨幣小幅走高，延續上周Fed升息後的漲勢。美元上周累計上漲逾1%，當美元走強，以其他貨幣計價的投資人購買黃金的成本會跟著上升。
道明證券(TD Securities)全球大宗商品策略主管Bart Melek表示：「問題仍在於，儘管油價近期有所下滑，但市場仍強烈反映Fed升息預期……過去幾天美元略有走強，而這通常對金價不利。」
Fed上周已升息，Fed主席華許(Kevin Warsh)也暗示，未來幾個月可能還會進一步升息。
根據芝商所(CME)FedWatch工具，交易員目前認為Fed 12月升息的機率達90%。
市場聚焦貨幣政策緊縮。聖路易聯準銀行總裁穆薩列姆(Alberto Musalem)及芝加哥聯準銀行總裁古爾斯比(Austan Goolsbee)均釋出訊號，認為Fed需要進一步升息，以壓低受到強勁需求及能源價格上漲推動的通膨。
自伊朗戰爭2月底爆發以來，能源價格上漲加劇市場對通膨的疑慮，迫使全球各國央行採取限制性貨幣政策立場。這使金價承受壓力，自今年1月創下每盎司5594.82美元的歷史新高後，已下跌逾22%。
儘管黃金傳統上被視為通膨避險資產，但在高利率環境下，由於黃金本身不孳息，相較於能產生收益的資產，黃金的吸引力會下降。
受波斯灣供應前景改善影響，油價周二跌至兩周低點。伊朗釋出訊號，可能在七天內重新開放荷姆茲海峽，與此同時，沙烏地阿拉伯也準備恢復從延布港(Yanbu)出口原油。

其他貴金屬交易


現貨白銀持平，報每盎司66.04美元。
現貨白金上揚1%，報每盎司1816.22美元。
現貨鈀金下跌0.7%，報每盎司1291.69美元。
paras_en: Gold fell again on Tuesday (22nd), as markets reinforced the view that the Federal Reserve will pursue a restrictive monetary policy, while traders closely monitor developments in the Middle East.
Gold spot fell 0.2%, trading at $4,336.21 per ounce. U.S. gold futures fell 0.2%, trading at $4,376.40 per ounce.

The U.S. dollar rose modestly against six major currencies, continuing the upward trend after last week’s Fed rate hike. The dollar gained more than 1% over the week, and a stronger dollar raises the cost for investors buying gold priced in other currencies.

Bart Melek, global commodity strategist at TD Securities, said, “The problem remains that, even though oil prices have recently eased, the market still strongly reflects expectations of Fed rate hikes… In recent days the dollar has edged higher, which is typically adverse to gold.”
Last week the Fed raised rates, and Fed Chair Kevin Warsh hinted that further hikes could come in the coming months.
According to the CME FedWatch tool, traders currently see a 90% probability of a December Fed rate hike.

The market is focused on monetary tightening. Saint Louis Fed President Alberto Musalem and Chicago Fed President Austan Goolsbee both signaled that the Fed needs to raise rates further to curb inflation driven by strong demand and rising energy prices.

Since the Iran war erupted at the end of February, rising energy prices have intensified inflation concerns, forcing central banks worldwide to adopt restrictive monetary stances. This has pressured gold, which fell more than 22% since its January record high of $5,594.82 per ounce.

Although gold is traditionally seen as an inflation hedge, in a high‑interest‑rate environment its appeal diminishes because gold itself yields no income, making it less attractive compared to income‑generating assets.
Other precious metals: Spot silver held flat at $66.04 per ounce. Spot platinum rose 1% to $1,816.22 per ounce. Spot palladium fell 0.7% to $1,291.69 per ounce.

items.title: 巴菲特卸任告別信留下「4字箴言」 點破投資市場不敗法則
items.title_en: Buffett Steps Down with a Farewell Letter Containing a “Four‑Word Maxim” that Reveals an Unbeatable Investment Rule
paras: 巴菲特上周五(18日)無預警發布了一封告別信，宣布即刻卸下波克夏(BRK.A-US) 董事長職位，結束長達61年的掌舵生涯。一如既往，這位「奧瑪哈先知」在信中展現其睿智哲理，其中包含了極具震撼力「四字投資箴言」。
以下是巴菲特的談話內容及其對投資人的啟示。
他在信中寫道：「日前，我和親友一同慶祝了我的 96 歲大壽，其中也包括我剛滿一歲的曾孫。現在他的行動速度可是比我快多了。」
隨後，巴菲特宣布卸下自1970年以來擔任的董事長職務，轉任榮譽董事長。他的兒子霍華．巴菲特（Howard Buffett）已在波克夏董事會任職33年，並接任董事長一職。
接著，巴菲特寫下四個發人深省的字，所有投資人都應將其視為一記警鐘：「時間終會勝出。」(Father Time always wins)
一方面，這句話指的是人終將老去；另一方面，這四個字也概括了巴菲特的投資理念。對投資人意味著什麼？「無論在人生或股市，時間終究都是最後贏家。」
巴菲特採取「買進並持有」策略，運用時間與複利，逐步將小額部位轉化為龐大的財富引擎。這項策略讓他成為億萬富豪，也使波克夏成長為市值兆美元級企業。
他也從不避諱公開宣揚這項理念。巴菲特1996年曾表示：「如果你不願意持有一檔股票10年，那就連持有10分鐘都不要考慮。」
另一件未曾改變的事，就是美國股市長期始終走高。過去50年來，標普500指數累計上漲2,100%；若計入股息再投資，總報酬率更達4,530%。難怪巴菲特的名言眾所周知：「我們最喜歡的持有期限是永遠。」
巴菲特並未以「時間終會勝出」作為告別信的結尾。他接著寫道：「然而，時間一直對我十分慷慨，讓我有機會看到波克夏發展到今天這個階段，也讓我對公司的未來比以往任何時候都更有信心。」
回顧標普 500 指數的歷史，很難不對股市的長期走勢抱持信心。即使歷經網路泡沫破裂與經濟大蕭條等重大崩盤，持續留在市場中的投資人，長期仍能獲得可觀報酬，平均表現遠遠勝過頻繁進出的短線客。
因此，即使巴菲特不再擔任波克夏董事長，他的建議與買進持有哲學，在時間的助力下，依然會是贏家。
paras_en: Last Friday (the 18th), Warren Buffett unexpectedly issued a farewell letter announcing that he is stepping down immediately from his role as chairman of Berkshire Hathaway (BRK.A‑US), ending a 61‑year tenure at the helm. As always, the “Oracle of Omaha” displayed his characteristic wisdom in the letter, which includes a striking four‑character investment maxim.
Below is the content of Buffett’s remarks and the insights they offer to investors.
He wrote in the letter: “Recently I celebrated my 96th birthday with family and friends, including my great‑great‑grandson who just turned one. He moves much faster than I do now.”

Buffett then announced that he is relinquishing the chairman position he has held since 1970, becoming honorary chairman. His son Howard Buffett, who has served on Berkshire’s board for 33 years, will assume the chairmanship.
Next, Buffett penned four thought‑provoking words that every investor should take as a warning: “Time always wins.”

On one hand, the phrase points to the fact that people inevitably age; on the other, those four words encapsulate Buffett’s investment philosophy. What does it mean for investors? “Whether in life or in the stock market, time is ultimately the final winner.”

Buffett has employed a “buy‑and‑hold” strategy, using time and compounding to gradually turn modest positions into a massive wealth engine. This approach made him a billionaire and grew Berkshire into a trillion‑dollar‑market‑cap enterprise.
He has never shied away from publicly championing this idea. In 1996, Buffett said, “If you’re not willing to hold a stock for ten years, don’t even think about holding it for ten minutes.”

Another unchanging fact is that the U.S. stock market has risen over the long term. Over the past 50 years the S&P 500 has risen 2,100%; with dividend reinvestment the total return reaches 4,530%. No wonder Buffett’s famous saying is, “Our favorite holding period is forever.”

Buffett did not end his farewell letter with “Time always wins.” He went on to write, “However, time has been very generous to me, giving me the chance to see Berkshire develop to where it is today, and it makes me more confident about the company’s future than ever before.”

Looking back at the history of the S&P 500, it is hard not to feel confident about the market’s long‑term trajectory. Even after major crashes such as the dot‑com bust and the Great Depression, investors who stayed in the market have, over the long run, earned substantial returns, far outperforming frequent short‑term traders.
Therefore, even though Buffett is no longer chairman of Berkshire, his advice and buy‑and‑hold philosophy, bolstered by the power of time, will continue to be a winning approach.

items.title: 高通一次推兩款新手機晶片 聚焦AI代理
items.title_en: Qualcomm Launches Two New Mobile Chips, Focusing on AI Agents
paras: 《Yahoo Finance》報導，高通(Qualcomm)(QCOM-US)周二(22日)在夏威夷茂宜島(Maui)舉行的年度Snapdragon峰會上，推出最新手機晶片。
高通表示，其Snapdragon 8 Elite Extreme Gen 6與Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 6，都是針對智慧代理AI所設計。
高通認為，讓AI代理與AI模型直接在裝置上運行，可以成為一種成本更低的替代方案，讓用戶不必付費透過雲端運行應用程式。
高通行動手機部門資深副總裁暨總經理Chris Patrick在聲明中表示，「今天是一個重要里程碑，我們一次推出兩款全新的旗艦行動平台，帶來即時、個人化且能適應需求的智慧代理AI體驗。」
他補充，「隨著智慧代理AI時代持續發展，我們的雙旗艦策略讓我們能夠突破行動裝置的可能性，同時將最新的AI創新帶給更廣泛的高階裝置。」
高通的手機晶片廣泛應用於全球高階Android裝置，包括小米、Motorola、中興通訊等品牌。
這家行動晶片巨頭正進行大規模轉型，希望降低對智慧型手機市場的依賴，並投入AI資料中心等成長領域。
高通在6月舉行的投資人日活動中，進一步說明了實現這項目標的計畫，公布一系列資料中心元件與伺服器產品，並宣布將2029會紀年度非手機業務營收預測幾乎提高一倍至400億美元。
高通最初開始降低對智慧型手機營收的依賴，是轉向邊緣裝置，包括筆記型電腦、智慧眼鏡以及自動駕駛車輛技術等產品。
不過，智慧型手機相關銷售仍持續推動高通營收。在7月公布的財報中，高通涵蓋智慧型手機、物聯網與汽車業務的CDMA Technologies部門營收，於該季貢獻85億美元，占高通總營收99億美元一大部分。其中，手機業務營收達到51億美元以上，汽車相關業務營收則達到15億美元。
高通股價周二上漲2.08%，至每股198.27美元。
paras_en: Yahoo Finance reported that Qualcomm (QCOM-US) on Tuesday the 22nd held its annual Snapdragon Summit on Maui, Hawaii, where it unveiled its latest mobile chips.
Qualcomm said its Snapdragon 8 Elite Extreme Gen 6 and Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 6 are both designed for smart‑agent AI.
Qualcomm believes that running AI agents and models directly on devices can be a lower‑cost alternative, letting users avoid paying for cloud‑based application execution.

Chris Patrick, senior vice president and general manager of Qualcomm’s mobile phone division, said in a statement, "Today is a major milestone – we are launching two brand‑new flagship mobile platforms that deliver real‑time, personalized, demand‑adaptive smart‑agent AI experiences."

He added, "As the era of smart‑agent AI continues to evolve, our dual‑flagship strategy enables us to push the boundaries of mobile devices while bringing the latest AI innovations to a broader range of premium devices."
Qualcomm’s mobile chips are widely used in high‑end Android devices worldwide, including brands such as Xiaomi, Motorola and ZTE.
The mobile‑chip giant is undergoing a large‑scale transformation, aiming to reduce its reliance on the smartphone market and invest in growth areas such as AI data centers.

At its investor day in June, Qualcomm further outlined its plan to achieve this goal, unveiling a suite of data‑center components and server products and announcing that its non‑phone revenue forecast for 2029 would almost double to $40 billion.
Qualcomm initially began reducing its dependence on smartphone revenue by shifting toward edge devices, including laptops, smart glasses and autonomous‑vehicle technologies.

Nevertheless, smartphone‑related sales continue to drive Qualcomm’s revenue. In its July earnings release, the CDMA Technologies segment covering smartphones, IoT and automotive contributed $8.5 billion that quarter, a large share of Qualcomm’s total $9.9 billion revenue, with mobile business revenue exceeding $5.1 billion and automotive‑related revenue reaching $1.5 billion.
Qualcomm’s stock rose 2.08% on Tuesday to $198.27 per share.

items.title: 油價成ECB關鍵指標 德國央行總裁：高能源價格恐迫使升息
items.title_en: Oil Prices Become Key Indicator for ECB, German Central Bank President Says High Energy Prices May Force Rate Hikes
paras: 油價正成為歐洲央行(ECB)制定利率政策時日益重要的觀察指標。德國央行(Bundesbank)總裁納格爾(Joachim Nagel)表示, 儘管油價並非ECB決策時唯一或最重要的依據, 但過去4年來其重要性已明顯提高, 如果能源價格持續處於高檔, ECB可能需要將貨幣政策推向溫和限制性區域。
納格爾周二(22日)在倫敦專業經濟學家協會(Society of Professional Economists)舉辦的活動上表示, 油價「絕對不是唯一的指標」, 但近4年來已成為「更相關的指標」。他指出, ECB管理委員會在制定利率決策時, 必須觀察油價並將其納入考量。
市場近期大幅提高對ECB進一步升息的押注, 主因中東戰事推升原油與天然氣價格, 加劇歐元區通膨風險。ECB今年夏季已兩度升息, 目前政策利率為2.5%, 市場則預期未來12個月可能再升息3至4次。
ECB面臨的另一項壓力來自能源價格已接近其較嚴重情境的假設。若油價與天然氣價格持續高企, 市場預期歐元區通膨率可能升至約4%, 約為ECB 2%通膨目標的兩倍。
不過, ECB總裁拉加德(Christine Lagarde)與副總裁武伊契奇(Boris Vujcic)近期均試圖降低市場對能源價格與升息之間直接連動的預期。兩人強調, ECB並不會單純因油價上升就機械式調高利率, 而是需要綜合評估通膨、經濟成長、家庭所得、消費及其他經濟數據。
武伊契奇日前表示, 市場近期對能源價格的敏感度明顯提高, 但ECB仍採逐次會議決策方式, 不會針對未來利率路徑提供明確指引。他指出, 油價對整體通膨的傳導速度較快, 主要透過燃料價格迅速反映在消費者物價上; 天然氣的影響則可能更持久, 不僅直接影響家庭能源帳單, 也會透過生產成本間接推升商品價格。
納格爾則表示, ECB目前2.5%的利率大致處於既不限制經濟成長, 也不刺激經濟活動的區域。但如果能源價格進一步上升, 他「不能排除」ECB必須把貨幣政策推向「溫和限制性」區域。
這番談話凸顯ECB目前面臨的政策兩難。一方面, 高油價與天然氣價格可能進一步推升通膨, 要求央行維持甚至提高利率; 另一方面, 能源成本上升也會侵蝕家庭實質所得、抑制消費, 並增加企業成本, 最終對經濟成長形成壓力。
武伊契奇先前也指出, 如果通膨在秋季持續處於高位並影響家庭收入與消費行為, 經濟成長可能因此受到抑制。因此, 單純觀察能源價格並不足以判斷未來利率走向, ECB仍須將更廣泛的經濟關係納入考量。
ECB首席經濟學家連恩(Philip Lane)則表示, 近期能源價格衝擊可能比原先預期持續更久, 地緣政治緊張升高進一步加劇油氣價格壓力。他預期, 第二波能源價格上漲將帶來更高且更持久的通膨, 但通膨率最終仍將逐步下降, 預計自2027年年中開始回到ECB目標附近。
油價近期的大幅波動也讓能源因素重新成為全球央行政策討論核心。中東局勢導致市場擔憂原油供應受阻, Brent與WTI原油價格一度大幅上漲, 進而推升市場對主要央行升息的預期。隨著近期中東原油流量改善以及荷姆茲海峽重新開放的可能性增加, 油價已從高點回落, 但能源價格是否能持續下降, 仍將成為ECB評估通膨與利率政策的重要變數。
納格爾的最新說法也顯示, ECB目前並未排除進一步升息的可能性, 但未來決策仍將取決於能源價格、通膨走勢以及經濟活動等多項數據。市場目前對未來數次升息的預期, 與ECB官員強調「逐次會議決策」的立場之間, 仍存在明顯落差。
paras_en: Oil prices are becoming an increasingly important indicator for the European Central Bank (ECB) when setting interest rate policy. Joachim Nagel, President of the German Bundesbank, said that although oil prices are not the sole or most important factor for ECB decisions, their importance has risen markedly over the past four years, and if energy prices remain high, the ECB may need to move monetary policy into a mildly restrictive zone.

Nagel said on Tuesday (22) at an event hosted by the Society of Professional Economists in London that oil prices "are absolutely not the only indicator," but have become a "more relevant indicator" over the past four years. He noted that the ECB Governing Council must monitor oil prices and incorporate them into its rate decisions.

Markets have recently sharply increased bets on further ECB rate hikes, largely due to Middle East conflicts driving up crude and natural gas prices and heightening inflation risks in the euro area. The ECB has raised rates twice this summer, bringing the policy rate to 2.5%, and markets now expect 3 to 4 more hikes over the next 12 months.

Another pressure on the ECB comes from energy prices approaching scenarios of greater severity. If oil and gas prices remain high, markets expect euro‑area inflation to rise to about 4%, roughly twice the ECB’s 2% target.

However, ECB President Christine Lagarde and Vice‑President Boris Vujcic have recently tried to reduce market expectations of a direct link between energy prices and rate hikes. They stressed that the ECB will not mechanically raise rates simply because oil prices rise, but will instead assess inflation, economic growth, household income, consumption and other data comprehensively.

Vujcic recently noted that market sensitivity to energy prices has risen sharply, but the ECB will still decide on a step‑by‑step basis and will not provide explicit guidance on future rate paths. He pointed out that oil prices transmit to overall inflation quickly, mainly through fuel prices reflected in consumer prices, while natural gas may have a more lasting impact, affecting household energy bills and indirectly pushing up product prices through production costs.

Nagel said the current 2.5% rate is roughly in a zone that neither restrains economic growth nor stimulates activity. But if energy prices rise further, he "cannot rule out" that the ECB must move monetary policy into a "mildly restrictive" area.

This discussion highlights the policy dilemma the ECB currently faces. On one hand, high oil and gas prices could further push inflation, requiring the central bank to maintain or raise rates; on the other hand, rising energy costs erode household real income, dampen consumption, and increase business costs, ultimately putting pressure on economic growth.

Vujcic also noted that if inflation remains high in the fall and affects household income and consumption behavior, economic growth could be suppressed. Therefore, simply observing energy prices is insufficient to determine future rate paths, and the ECB must incorporate broader economic relationships.

Philip Lane, ECB chief economist, said that recent energy price shocks may last longer than initially expected, with geopolitical tensions further amplifying oil and gas price pressures. He expects a second wave of energy price rises to bring higher and more persistent inflation, but inflation will ultimately ease gradually, returning near the ECB target around mid‑2027.

The recent sharp swings in oil prices have also brought energy factors back to the center of global central bank policy discussions. Middle East tensions have raised concerns about supply disruptions, with Brent and WTI crude prices spiking and boosting expectations of major central bank rate hikes. As Middle East crude flows improve and the Strait of Hormuz potentially reopens, oil prices have fallen from their highs, but whether energy prices will continue to decline remains a key variable for the ECB’s inflation and rate policy assessment.

Nagel’s latest remarks also show that the ECB has not ruled out further rate hikes, but future decisions will still depend on energy prices, inflation trends, and economic activity among other data. The market’s expectations for future hikes still diverge noticeably from the ECB officials’ emphasis on a "step‑by‑step" decision stance.

items.title: 〈台泥拓展東歐市場〉擬以212億元企業價值 併購烏克蘭第二大水泥公司
items.title_en: Taiwan Cement Expands into Eastern Europe with a 21.2‑Billion‑NTD Valuation to Acquire Ukraine's Second‑Largest Cement Company
paras: 台泥(1101-TW)今(23)日召開重大訊息記者會，臨時董事會通過授權集團旗下荷蘭子公司TCC Group EMEA Holdings B.V.，以不超過7.5億歐元、約新台幣212億元的企業價值，收購烏克蘭水泥建材公司Ivano-Frankivskcement（IFCEM）等公司100%股權，進一步將歐洲水泥版圖由南歐、西歐延伸至東歐。
IFCEM為烏克蘭第二大水泥公司，正式員工超過2,500人，市占率約36%，公司建材年產能約400萬噸，2025年水泥營收占比約95%。除水泥外，事業範圍還涵蓋預拌混凝土、骨材、屋頂建材、石膏製品及乾混砂漿，台泥此次收購範圍除IFCEM及其子公司外，也包括屋頂建材公司Ivano-Frankivsk-Dakh、石膏製品公司KRU Gips與乾混砂漿公司KRU Mix。
另根據IFCEM網路上公開年報，2025年營收年增20.3%，毛利64.42億格里夫納、年增40.3%，毛利率39.6%，較2024年增加5.6個百分點；營業利益53.77億格里夫納，年增51.2%，稅後淨利則年增44.5%，淨利率約26.4%；EBITDA為64.73億格里夫納，年增46.2%，EBITDA率39.8%，顯示公司在戰爭期間仍維持生產及獲利能力。
台泥指出，IFCEM具備銷售至鄰近東歐國家的業務網絡，出口市場以波蘭、羅馬尼亞為主，另供應摩爾多瓦、斯洛伐克與匈牙利；若本案完成，台泥將把集團在低碳研發與生產等領域的經驗導入IFCEM，進一步拓展東歐市場。
台泥指出，此次收購標的將直屬台泥荷蘭控股公司，不會納入預計於歐洲上市的Cimpor International架構之下，也保留引進國際金融機構共同投資人的彈性，目前已有超國家金融基金（Supranational Funds）表達投資意願。
台泥表示，本案委請Morgan Stanley擔任評價財務顧問，並由國際法律、財務會計、稅務及環境顧問進行盡職調查，針對制裁、勞動力、營運及外匯管制等風險逐項檢視，實際交易金額將於交割時，依淨負債及淨營運資金等項目調整。本交易尚須取得台灣、烏克蘭等多地主管機關核准後，方能完成交割。
paras_en: Taiwan Cement (1101‑TW) held a major news conference today (the 23rd), where an emergency board authorized its Dutch subsidiary TCC Group EMEA Holdings B.V. to acquire 100% of Ukrainian cement and building materials company Ivano‑Frankivskcement (IFCEM) and related entities for up to €750 million, roughly NT$212 billion in enterprise value, extending the group’s European cement footprint from Southern and Western Europe into Eastern Europe.

IFCEM is Ukraine’s second‑largest cement producer, employing more than 2,500 staff and holding about a 36% market share. The company’s annual building‑materials capacity is around 4 million tonnes, with cement accounting for roughly 95% of its 2025 revenue. In addition to cement, its business includes ready‑mix concrete, aggregates, roofing materials, gypsum products and dry‑mix mortar. The Taiwan Cement acquisition covers IFCEM and its subsidiaries as well as roofing‑materials firm Ivano‑Frankivsk‑Dakh, gypsum‑product company KRU Gips and dry‑mix mortar company KRU Mix.

According to IFCEM’s publicly posted annual report, 2025 revenue is projected to grow 20.3% year‑on‑year, with gross profit of UAH 6.442 billion—a 40.3% increase—and a gross margin of 39.6%, up 5.6 percentage points from 2024. Operating profit is expected at UAH 5.377 billion, up 51.2%, while after‑tax net profit should rise 44.5% to a net margin of about 26.4%. EBITDA is forecast at UAH 6.473 billion, a 46.2% rise, giving an EBITDA margin of 39.8%, indicating the company has maintained production and profitability despite the war.

Taiwan Cement noted that IFCEM has a sales network reaching neighboring Eastern‑European countries, with exports mainly to Poland and Romania and supplies also to Moldova, Slovakia and Hungary. If the deal closes, Taiwan Cement will bring its low‑carbon R&D and production expertise to IFCEM, further expanding its presence in the Eastern‑European market.

Taiwan Cement said the acquisition target will be directly owned by its Dutch holding company and will not be placed under the Cimpor International structure that is planned for a future European listing. The deal retains flexibility to bring in international financial institutions as co‑investors, and supranational funds have already expressed interest.

Taiwan Cement disclosed that Morgan Stanley has been engaged as valuation and financial adviser, with international legal, accounting, tax and environmental advisors conducting due diligence. Risks related to sanctions, labor, operations and foreign‑exchange controls are being examined item by item, and the final transaction price will be adjusted at closing for net debt and net working capital. The transaction still requires approvals from regulators in Taiwan, Ukraine and other jurisdictions before it can be completed.

paras_en: Benefiting from the rapid expansion of demand for AI, high‑performance computing and cloud services, the Ministry of Economic Affairs on Tuesday (22nd) released August export order statistics. The order value for the month reached a whopping US$102.96 billion, not only continuing a streak of 19 consecutive months of growth after 18 months in July, but also marking the first time Taiwan’s monthly orders have broken the US$100 billion threshold in history. The year‑over‑year growth rate was a staggering 71.4%, setting a new historic high, driven mainly by electronics and information‑communication products which grew 83.9% to 100.5% year‑over‑year, with the United States as the largest source of orders, accounting for US$42.13 billion in August, a near‑90% YoY increase.

On Tuesday (22nd) the Taiwan stock index surged as much as 883 points, climbing to 48,601 points and setting a new all‑time high, but finished the session weakly, closing at the low of 47,800 points, up only 81 points. All three major institutional investors were net buyers, with foreign investors posting a fourth consecutive day of net buying. Funds poured into the panel sector, snapping up 240,000 shares of AU Optronics, and a total of 480,000 shares over two days.

Chip‑maker Xintrax (5274‑TW) opened on Tuesday (22nd) with a gap up, trading at the limit‑up price of NT$21,800, hitting a historic high and becoming the first Taiwan‑listed stock ever to break the NT$20,000 mark, setting a new market record. The price rose by NT$1,980, also a record.

Container shipping company Yang Ming (2609‑TW) said at its Tuesday (22nd) earnings conference that although cargo volumes will gradually ease after the fourth‑quarter shipping off‑season begins, there is still no consensus on the passage and management rights of the Hormuz Strait and “the situation is rather severe.” Combined with the port‑congestion issue, the supply‑demand structure remains relatively stable, and overall the off‑season will only see a modest correction.

MediaTek (2454‑TW) on Tuesday (22nd) launched the first flagship SoC of its new Dimensity Compute Experiences (CX) platform, the Dimensity CX C10 Max, built on TSMC’s (2330‑TW) 3‑nanometer process. It is intended for the upcoming high‑end, ultra‑portable Google‑book, offering outstanding performance, advanced features, and excellent energy efficiency.

items.title: 川習會台灣成焦點！中國力阻140億美元軍售 川普態度受矚
items.title_en: Trump‑Xi Meeting Puts Taiwan in Spotlight as China Blocks $14 B Arms Sale; Trump’s Stance Watched
paras: 中國國家主席習近平將於周三(23日)抵達華盛頓，並在周四(24日)與美國總統川普舉行一日峰會。這是習近平時隔3年再次訪美，兩位全球最大經濟體領袖將尋求改善私人關係，並在貿易、人工智慧(AI)、關鍵礦產及美伊戰爭等爭議議題上尋找交集。
不過，對台灣而言，最值得關注的仍是兩岸議題。北京預料將阻止美國推動規模140億美元的對台軍售案列為重要目標，並可能再次要求華府正式宣示「反對台灣獨立」。外界也將緊盯，川普是否可能在台灣問題上做出某種讓步，換取中國在關稅、採購或稀土出口方面妥協。

北京力阻140億美元對台軍售

台灣向來是美中關係中最敏感、也最容易引發衝突的議題之一。北京主張台灣是中國領土一部分，美國則持續向台灣提供軍事支持，並與台灣維持緊密但非正式的關係。
中國官員此次關注的主要目標之一，是阻止美國推進規模達140億美元的對台軍售案。北京先前也曾要求川普政府正式表態「反對台灣獨立」，若能迫使華府改變現行措辭，將成為中國重大的外交成果。
川普5月在北京與習近平會晤後曾表示，雙方討論過美國對台軍售，並稱自己不希望捲入一場「距離9,500英里之外的戰爭」。
若本周峰會再次觸及台灣，市場關注的焦點將是川普是否願意調整對台政策，以換取北京在其他領域讓步。不過，目前沒有證據顯示雙方已就台灣進行利益交換，相關說法仍屬外界對談判風險的觀察。

貿易休兵能否延長成最可能成果

相較於台灣議題，美中在經貿領域仍有較大妥協空間。川普與習近平預料將尋求延長2025年10月達成的貿易休兵。這項協議降低雙方對彼此商品加徵的部分關稅，並暫停中國稀土等產品的部分出口管制措施。
美中會前也討論進一步降低美國能源與農產品等商品的關稅，並透過「貿易委員會」機制，降低雙方各300億美元商品的進口障礙，部分中國商品可能適用最惠國稅率。
不過，美國貿易代表葛里爾表示，美中對延長貿易休兵的條件仍有歧見，華府可以接受延長3至6個月。美國最高法院今年2月推翻川普的「對等關稅」後，華府也已對其他國家的貿易行為展開調查，未來可能據此對中國課徵7.5%的新關稅，但預料不會在川習會前正式宣布。
採購承諾也是峰會重點。中國正逐步履行2028年前每年購買2,500萬噸美國黃豆的承諾，今年採購進度已經過半，但額外購買至少170億美元美國農產品的目標較難達成。
中國前7個月進口的美國牛肉僅700萬美元，遠低於2025年的5.56億美元。中國雖於5月更新數百家美國牛肉加工廠的出口許可，但美國牛肉價格飆升及中國需求疲弱，持續壓抑進口。川普5月宣布中國承諾購買200架波音(BA-US)客機，葛里爾近日表示相關採購正在推進。
至於中國企業赴美投資，仍是更具政治爭議的議題。川普曾考慮允許中國車廠在美國設廠，條件是雇用美國勞工，但相關交易仍須通過國家安全審查，在美國國內也可能遭遇強烈反彈。

AI、稀土與伊朗成三大角力戰場

美中正在競逐全球AI主導權，雙方也都限制對方取得本國技術。中國先進AI模型與美國競爭對手的差距持續縮小，北京將AI視為扭轉科技競爭局勢的重要機會；華府則透過出口管制，限制輝達(NVDA-US)等美國企業向中國供應最先進晶片。
阿里巴巴(BABA-US)周二推出號稱中國最強大的AI晶片「真武V900」，並計劃大幅擴充資料中心，進一步凸顯中國加速降低對美國晶片依賴。美方則指控部分中國開發商利用美國模型輸出，以較低成本訓練競爭產品，並已推出措施防範所謂「對抗性蒸餾」。
稀土同樣是北京手中的重要談判籌碼。中國掌握全球大部分稀土開採及加工能力，美國短期內難以擺脫依賴。中國在去年貿易對峙期間限制稀土出口，雖在10月休兵後恢復部分供應，但美方抱怨北京拖延出貨，上月中國輸美稀土磁鐵數量也再度下降。知情人士透露，北京可能在峰會上提出核發更多出口許可。
美伊戰爭則是另一項地緣政治難題。中國是伊朗最大石油買家，也向德黑蘭提供一定程度的外交與經濟支持。川普預料將要求習近平減少與伊朗的往來，但北京已要求中國企業抵制美國針對伊朗石油交易的制裁，並強調中伊關係不應受到破壞。
相較關稅、商品採購與稀土許可，美中在台灣、AI及伊朗問題上的分歧更難化解。川習會即使能延長貿易休兵，台灣議題仍將是檢驗川普對中政策底線，以及美中關係能否避免走向更激烈對抗的關鍵。
paras_en: Chinese President Xi Jinping will arrive in Washington on Wednesday (the 23rd) and hold a one‑day summit with U.S. President Donald Trump on Thursday (the 24th). This is Xi’s first visit to the United States in three years, and the leaders of the world’s two largest economies will seek to improve personal ties and look for common ground on contentious issues such as trade, artificial intelligence (AI), critical minerals and the war in Iraq.

However, for Taiwan the most closely watched issue remains cross‑strait relations. Beijing expects to make blocking a $14 billion arms sale to Taiwan a key objective and may again demand that Washington formally declare its “opposition to Taiwanese independence.” Observers will also watch whether Trump might make any concession on Taiwan in exchange for Chinese compromises on tariffs, procurement or rare‑earth exports.

Beijing’s effort to block the $14 billion arms sale to Taiwan
Taiwan has long been the most sensitive and conflict‑prone issue in U.S.–China relations. Beijing claims Taiwan as part of Chinese territory, while the United States continues to provide military support to Taiwan and maintains a close but unofficial relationship with the island.

One of the main goals of Chinese officials on this trip is to stop the United States from moving forward with a $14 billion arms package for Taiwan. Beijing has previously asked the Trump administration to issue an official statement “opposing Taiwanese independence”; forcing Washington to change its current wording would be a major diplomatic win for China.
After his May meeting with Xi in Beijing, Trump said the two sides had discussed U.S. arms sales to Taiwan and that he did not want to be drawn into a war “9,500 miles away.”

If the summit this week again touches on Taiwan, the market’s focus will be whether Trump is willing to adjust his Taiwan policy in return for Chinese concessions in other areas. So far there is no evidence that the two sides have agreed to any quid‑pro‑quo on Taiwan, and such claims remain speculative observations about negotiation risk.

Can a trade truce be extended and become the most likely outcome?
Compared with the Taiwan issue, there is still considerable room for compromise in the economic and trade arena. Trump and Xi are expected to seek an extension of the trade truce reached in October 2025. That agreement reduces certain tariffs on each other’s goods and pauses some export controls on Chinese rare‑earth products.

Before the talks, the U.S. and China also discussed further lowering tariffs on U.S. energy and agricultural products, and using a “trade committee” mechanism to cut import barriers on $30 billion worth of goods on each side, with some Chinese products potentially qualifying for most‑favoured‑nation rates.

However, U.S. Trade Representative Katherine Tai said the two sides still disagree on the conditions for extending the trade truce, and Washington could accept an extension of three to six months. After the Supreme Court overturned Trump’s “reciprocal tariff” rule in February, the administration has launched investigations into other countries’ trade practices and may impose a new 7.5% tariff on China, though it is not expected to be announced before the Trump‑Xi summit.

Procurement commitments are also a summit focus. China is gradually fulfilling its pledge to buy 25 million tonnes of U.S. soybeans each year through 2028; the purchase pace this year is already more than half of the target, but reaching the additional goal of at least $17 billion in U.S. agricultural products will be difficult.

In the first seven months of the year China imported only $7 million of U.S. beef, far below the $556 million target for 2025. Although China refreshed export licences for hundreds of U.S. beef processors in May, soaring beef prices and weak Chinese demand continue to suppress imports. In May Trump announced that China had committed to buying 200 Boeing (BA‑US) aircraft, and Tai said the related procurement is progressing.

Chinese corporate investment in the United States remains a politically contentious issue. Trump has considered allowing Chinese automakers to set up plants in the U.S. on the condition that they hire American workers, but any deal would still need to pass a national‑security review and could face strong domestic backlash.

AI, rare‑earths and Iran are the three main battlegrounds
The United States and China are vying for global leadership in AI, and both sides are restricting the other’s access to domestic technology. China’s advanced AI models are closing the gap with U.S. rivals, and Beijing sees AI as a key lever to shift the tech‑competition balance; Washington, meanwhile, uses export controls to limit companies such as Nvidia (NVDA‑US) from supplying China with its most advanced chips.

Alibaba (BABA‑US) unveiled on Tuesday what it calls China’s most powerful AI chip, the “Zhenwu V900,” and plans a major data‑center expansion, underscoring China’s push to reduce reliance on U.S. chips. The U.S. accuses some Chinese developers of using exported U.S. models to train competing products at lower cost and has introduced measures to guard against so‑called “adversarial distillation.”

Rare‑earths are also a crucial bargaining chip for Beijing. China controls most of the world’s rare‑earth mining and processing capacity, and the United States cannot quickly wean itself off that dependence. China curtailed rare‑earth exports during last year’s trade standoff; although some supply resumed after the October truce, the U.S. complains Beijing is delaying shipments, and last month Chinese rare‑earth magnet shipments to the U.S. fell again. Insiders say Beijing may seek to issue more export licences at the summit.

The U.S.–Iran war is another geopolitical headache. China is Iran’s largest oil buyer and provides a degree of diplomatic and economic support to Tehran. Trump is expected to ask Xi to scale back ties with Iran, but Beijing has already urged Chinese firms to resist U.S. sanctions on Iranian oil transactions and stresses that the China‑Iran relationship should not be damaged.

Compared with tariffs, commodity procurement and rare‑earth licences, the divergences between the United States and China on Taiwan, AI and Iran are harder to resolve. Even if the Trump‑Xi summit manages to extend the trade truce, the Taiwan issue will remain the litmus test for Trump’s bottom line on China and for whether U.S.–China relations can avoid slipping into a more intense confrontation.
