items.title: 8月五大銀行新承做房貸月減近120億元 創3個月低
items.title_en: August Five Major Banks' New Mortgage Origination Down Nearly 120 Billion, Lowest in Three Months
paras: 台灣央行今(22)日公布8月五大銀行新承做房貸金額為571.65億元，月減119.44億元，並來到3個月來低點，而房貸利率則較上月彈升0.031個百分點至2.321%，創3個月來高。
央行說明，房貸承作額降低主要逢農曆7月影響市場部分交易量、颱風因素干擾銀行核貸作業並影響民眾看屋意願等，再加上新青安3.0上路所致。
由於利率相對較低的新青安房貸承做下滑，占房貸比重降至41.88%，創10個月來低點，也使房貸利率反彈。
整體來看，央行統計8月本國五大銀行(台銀、合庫銀、一銀、華銀及土銀)新承做放款加權平均利率為2.187%，月升0.020個百分點，儘管資本支出貸款利率下降，其餘各類貸款利率均上升。
而8月五大銀行不含國庫借款的新承做放款加權平均利率同為2.187%，月增0.02個百分點。
paras_en: The Central Bank of Taiwan announced today (22nd) that the amount of new mortgage loans originated by the five major banks in August was NT$571.65 billion, a monthly decrease of NT$119.44 billion, reaching the lowest level in three months, while the mortgage rate rose by 0.031 percentage points from the previous month to 2.321%, the highest in three months.

The central bank explained that the drop in mortgage origination was mainly due to the lunar July effect reducing market transaction volume, typhoon disruptions to banks' loan approval processes and dampening home‑viewing interest, as well as the rollout of the new “Qing‑An 3.0” program.

Because the relatively low‑rate Qing‑An mortgage saw a decline in origination, its share of total mortgages fell to 41.88%, the lowest in ten months, which also contributed to the rebound in mortgage rates.

Overall, the central bank’s statistics show that the weighted‑average rate of new loans issued by the five domestic banks (Bank of Taiwan, Cooperative Bank, First Bank, Hua Nan Bank and Land Bank) in August was 2.187%, up 0.020 percentage points month‑over‑month, even though the rate for capital‑expenditure loans fell while rates for all other loan categories rose.
The weighted‑average rate of new loans issued by the five major banks in August, excluding treasury borrowing, was also 2.187%, an increase of 0.02 percentage points from the previous month.

items.title: 鋼鐵公會：辦理輸歐盟鋼品出口配額管理 審核程序嚴謹並恪守公平、公正及保密原則
items.title_en: Taiwan Steel Association: Rigorous Review Process for EU Steel Export Quota Management Upholds Fairness, Impartiality, and Confidentiality
paras: 針對外界近期關注的「歐盟鋼鐵關稅配額管理及自由申請配額核配」一事，台灣鋼鐵工業同業公會今(22)日發出聲明表示，公會受經濟部國際貿易署委託辦理輸往歐盟鋼鐵產品放行前原產地證明書及加工證明書業務，相關配額管理均依主管機關公告之管理辦法及作業規範辦理，並秉持公平、公正及保密原則，配額比例則由貿易署核定，公會並未自行決定或調整。

鋼鐵公會指出，出口實績配額部分，是由貿易署依各廠商，包括貿易商，2022年至2024年平均出口量比例計算及分配後提供公會執行。至於因應歐盟新關稅配額措施所設立的「自由申請配額」，公會表示，主管機關今年6月依指示向鋼鐵業及出口業者進行意見調查，並綜合考量各類產品出口情況，同時參考2019年歐盟實施鋼鐵防衛措施期間的出口配額管理機制，研議並制定此次歐盟新關稅配額措施下的我國輸歐鋼品出口配額管理辦法，相關配額比例由貿易署核定。
鋼鐵公會說明，自由申請配額主要是協助過往沒有出口實績配額的新進鋼鐵製造商、出口實績配額較少的廠商及貿易商，或因應實際交易需求，提高國家配額使用效率，讓業者有機會爭取歐盟訂單。在申請資格方面，符合管理辦法規定的業者，包括出口實績配額已使用完畢，或獲配額度不足以履行單一交易的鋼鐵製造商及貿易商，均可提出申請；若業者未獲出口實績配額，則僅限鋼鐵製造商得免實績提出申請。
鋼鐵公會表示，申請業者須檢附申請書及與歐盟客戶簽訂的正式交易合約，公會審查時會逐項核對合約簽訂日、送貨目的地、預定出貨日及產品品項等條件，包括合約簽訂日須早於申請日、目的地須為歐盟地區、預定出貨日須於申請日後3個月內，且合約產品須精確符合申請類別，以確認申請具備實際出口需求。
此外，若申請量顯著超過業者歷年輸歐實績，或出現其他異常情形，公會也會再向申請廠商確認合約真實性及實際接單狀況，確認無誤後才納入當日核配計算。在核配方式上，鋼鐵公會指出，每一工作日收件截止後，若當日總申請量超過剩餘自由申請配額，將依各合格廠商申請量占當日合格總申請量的比例進行核配，數量核配完成後，再登錄至貿易署線上配額管理系統供業者查詢。
鋼鐵公會強調，配額管理系統設有權限控管機制，業者登入後僅能查詢自家公司獲配額度及該產品類別整體總額度，無法查詢其他業者的申請、獲配、放棄或轉讓額度等資訊，以確保業者商業機密及個資安全。
鋼鐵公會並表示，受貿易署委託辦理配額管理期間，將恪守保密義務，除依法令規定或主管機關要求外，不對外提供或揭露業者提交的交易合約、獲配額度及業務數據等個別商業機密與個資，並強調將持續依公平、公正及法遵原則，維護台灣鋼鐵產業出口秩序及整體產業權益。
paras_en: Regarding recent public attention on the EU steel tariff quota management and free application quota allocation, the Taiwan Steel Industry Association issued a statement on the 22nd stating that it has been commissioned by the Ministry of Economic Affairs’ International Trade Administration to handle certificates of origin and processing for steel products exported to the EU. All quota management follows the regulations and procedures announced by the competent authority, adheres to principles of fairness, impartiality and confidentiality, and the quota ratios are approved by the Trade Administration, not set or adjusted by the association itself.

The association explained that export performance quotas are calculated and allocated by the Trade Administration based on each company's, including traders’, average export volumes from 2022 to 2024, after which the association implements the allocations. In response to the EU’s new tariff quota measures, a “free application quota” was established. The authority conducted a survey of steel and export firms in June, considered export conditions of various products, and referenced the quota management mechanism used during the EU’s 2019 steel safeguard measures to draft the current quota management rules, with quota ratios again approved by the Trade Administration.

The free application quota is intended to help new steel manufacturers without export performance quotas, firms with limited export quotas, and traders, or to meet actual transaction needs and improve national quota utilization efficiency, giving them a chance to win EU orders. Eligible applicants—those whose export performance quota is exhausted or whose allocated quota is insufficient for a single transaction—may apply; if a firm has no export performance quota, only steel manufacturers may apply without performance proof.

Applicants must submit an application form and a formal sales contract with the EU customer. The association checks the contract’s signing date, delivery destination, planned shipment date and product specifications, ensuring the signing date precedes the application date, the destination is within the EU, the planned shipment is within three months of the application, and the product matches the requested category, confirming genuine export demand.

If the requested quantity far exceeds the applicant’s historical EU exports or other anomalies arise, the association will verify the contract’s authenticity and actual order status with the applicant before including it in that day’s allocation calculation. Allocation is performed daily: after the receipt deadline, if total requests exceed the remaining free quota, each qualified applicant receives a share proportional to its request relative to the total qualified requests, after which the results are entered into the Trade Administration’s online quota system for firms to view.

The quota management system includes access controls; once logged in, a firm can only view its own allocated quota and the overall total for that product category, not other firms’ applications, allocations, relinquishments or transfers, thereby protecting commercial confidentiality and personal data security.

During the period it handles quota management on behalf of the Trade Administration, the association will uphold confidentiality obligations, disclosing no individual contracts, allocated quotas or business data unless required by law or the competent authority, and stresses that it will continue to maintain fairness, impartiality and legal compliance to protect Taiwan’s steel export order and industry interests.

items.title: 主計總處：台灣8月失業率為3.41% 創26年來同期低
items.title_en: Directorate-General of Budget, Accounting and Statistics: Taiwan's August unemployment rate 3.41%, lowest in 26 years
paras: 主計總處今(22)日公布我國8月失業率為3.41%，較上月上升0.02個百分點，但年減0.04個百分點，為26個年度以來同期最低，反映勞動市場穩定，累計前8月失業率平均為3.33%，年減0.02個百分點；主計總處也說明，非典型就業統計也將在10月開始公布，以反映非典型就業的增加。
主計總處指出，8月失業人數為41萬1000人，月增2000人或0.63%，主因應屆畢業生投入尋職行列，初次尋職失業者續增3000人；與去年同期相比，失業人數反而減少4000人或0.97%。
而前8月失業人數平均為40萬1000人，年減2000人或0.36%。
從就業面來看，8月就業人數為1165萬5000人，月增4000人或0.03%，其中服務業部門增加4000人或0.05%，農業部門增2000人或0.53%，工業部門則減2000人或0.07%；與去年同期相比，增加1萬4000人或0.12%。
前8月就業人數平均為1164萬3000人，年增2萬3000人或0.20%。
與主要國家相比，我國最新失業率為3.46%，加拿大7.3%，美國4.3%，德國4.2%，香港4.0%，日本2.4%，南韓2.0%，主計總處說明，日本與韓國失業率相對低主要是因非典型就業人口多，而台灣的非典就業統計將於10月發布。
paras_en: The Directorate-General of Budget, Accounting and Statistics announced today (the 22nd) that Taiwan's unemployment rate for August was 3.41%, up 0.02 percentage points from the previous month but down 0.04 percentage points year‑on‑year, marking the lowest level for the same month in the past 26 years and indicating a stable labour market. The average unemployment rate for the first eight months was 3.33%, down 0.02 percentage points year‑on‑year, and the agency also said that statistics on atypical employment will begin to be released in October to reflect the rise in such jobs.

The agency noted that the number of unemployed persons in August was 411,000, an increase of 2,000 people or 0.63% from the previous month, mainly due to fresh graduates entering the job‑search pool, with first‑time job seekers rising by 3,000. Compared with the same period last year, the unemployed count actually fell by 4,000 people or 0.97%.
The average number of unemployed persons for the first eight months was 401,000, a year‑on‑year decrease of 2,000 people or 0.36%.

In terms of employment, August saw 11,655,000 employed persons, up 4,000 people or 0.03% from the previous month. The services sector added 4,000 jobs or 0.05%, agriculture added 2,000 jobs or 0.53%, while industry lost 2,000 jobs or 0.07%. Compared with the same month last year, employment increased by 14,000 people or 0.12%.
The average employment figure for the first eight months was 11,643,000, a year‑on‑year increase of 22,000 people or 0.20%.

Compared with major economies, Taiwan's latest unemployment rate stands at 3.46%, versus 7.3% in Canada, 4.3% in the United States, 4.2% in Germany, 4.0% in Hong Kong, 2.4% in Japan and 2.0% in South Korea. The agency explained that Japan’s and Korea’s lower rates are mainly due to a larger share of atypical employment, and Taiwan’s atypical employment statistics will be released in October.

items.title: 三商家購通過分割案 轉型為投控公司
items.title_en: SANSJIA Shopping Completes Split and Transforms into an Investment Holding Company
paras: 三商家購(2945-TW)今(22)日發布重訊指出，董事會決議通過公司分割案，將以分割方式將原經營的「美廉社」、「心樸市集」、「美廉便利架」、「Go美廉」等零售通路品牌相關資產、負債及營業，分割移轉予持股100%子公司富達零售，三商家購則轉型為投資控股公司，並更名為「眾聯投資控股股份有限公司」，負責集團資源整體規劃及智慧零售投資布局。
三商家購說明，此屬既有集團組織架構的重組與調整，對三商家購股東現有
股東權益並無影響，而集團管理效能與營運效率可望獲進一步提升，旗下各事業體將各自分工專注各自領域經營，未來將以策略投資或合資方式繼續納入策略合作夥伴，加速擴大零售經營規模。
本次分割基準日暫定為2027年1月1日，分割讓與的營業價值預計為新台幣2.5億元，換取富達零售新發行普通股2,500萬股，而有關零售通路分割案及轉型為投資控股公司相關議案，將11月18日召開的2026年度第一次股東臨時會中提請討論與決議。
轉型後，眾聯投控股票代號仍為2945，並將依相關規定向主管機關申請維持繼續上市資格。
未來富達零售將專注於零售通路品牌經營，實體通路除原來經營的便利商店OKmart和智能販賣機OKmini外，將新增「美廉社」、「心樸市集」、「美廉便利架」等三個實體通路品牌，線上通路則有「Go美廉」等。
三商家購進一步說明，未來購達行銷將聚焦於物流業務經營，首要目標為積極提升物流配送效率並逐步發展第三方物流服務；三友藥妝則負責藥妝通路拓展；寵物好事則持續深耕寵物食品及用品販售領域。
paras_en: SANSJIA Shopping (2945-TW) announced today (22nd) that its board of directors has approved a corporate split plan. The company will transfer the assets, liabilities, and operations of its retail channel brands—including Meilian Club, Xinpu Market, Meilian Convenience Shelf, and Go Meilian—to its wholly‑owned subsidiary Fuda Retail. SANSJIA Shopping will then transform into an investment holding company and rename itself "Zhonglian Investment Holding Co., Ltd.," responsible for overall group resource planning and smart‑retail investment strategy.
SANSJIA Shopping explained that this is a reorganization and adjustment of the existing group structure and will not affect the current equity of its shareholders.

The split is expected to further improve group management efficiency and operational effectiveness. Each business unit will focus on its own domain, and the group will continue to bring in strategic partners through strategic investments or joint ventures to accelerate the expansion of its retail scale.

The provisional split record date is set for January 1, 2027. The transferred business is valued at approximately NT$250 million, which will be exchanged for 25 million newly issued ordinary shares of Fuda Retail. The related split and transformation proposals will be presented for discussion and approval at the first extraordinary shareholders’ meeting for 2026, scheduled for November 18.
After the transformation, Zhonglian Investment Holding will retain the stock code 2945 and will apply to the regulator to maintain its listing status in accordance with applicable rules.

Going forward, Fuda Retail will focus on operating the retail channel brands. In addition to its existing convenience store OKmart and smart vending machine OKmini, it will add three physical retail brands—Meilian Club, Xinpu Market, and Meilian Convenience Shelf—while its online channel will include Go Meilian and others.

SANSJIA Shopping further explained that its marketing arm, Gouda Marketing, will concentrate on logistics operations, aiming first to improve delivery efficiency and gradually develop third‑party logistics services; Sanyou Cosmetics will handle the expansion of its drugstore and cosmetics channels; and Pet Good Things will continue to deepen its business in pet food and supplies.

items.title: NAND不再只是儲存商品 SanDisk目標價喊到2400美元、還能漲30％
items.title_en: NAND Is No Longer Just a Storage Commodity – SanDisk’s Target Price Hits $2,400, Still Up 30%
paras: 在人工智慧（AI）帶動記憶體與儲存需求激增下，SanDisk(SNDKV-US) 股價今年大幅飆升。隨著相關技術快速發展，分析師認為，該公司的業務定位正迎來轉變。
SanDisk 的 NAND 快閃記憶體過去通常被視為大宗儲存產品，但 Rosenblatt 分析師凱西迪（Kevin Cassidy）在最新報告中指出，新一代 AI 系統正為 NAND 創造重新定位的機會，使其從一般儲存產品轉變為 AI 基礎設施中更關鍵的系統元件。
凱西迪也首次將 SanDisk 納入追蹤研究，給予買進評等。NAND 快閃記憶體屬於非揮發性記憶體，這意味著它能在無須持續供電的情況下保存資料。
凱西迪表示，過去個人電腦、智慧手機及其他消費電子產品對 NAND 的需求，主要由儲存密度提升與每位元成本下降所驅動。
儲存密度是指 NAND 快閃記憶體在一定實體空間內可容納的資料量，每位元成本則是 NAND 記憶單元儲存每單位資料的成本。
不過，隨著 AI 模型規模擴大，加上推論程序需要處理大量資料，市場考量正從追求最低絕對價格，逐漸轉向更重視儲存密度、效能、耐用度及供應穩定性。所謂推論，是指 AI 模型依據已學習的模式進行預測。
SanDisk 的技術藍圖涵蓋與日本鎧俠（Kioxia）共同開發的 BiCS8 與 BiCS10 架構，透過垂直堆疊記憶體單元，在更小的空間內實現更高儲存容量，這項優勢完美呼應了凱西迪所看好的願景，將使 NAND 「進一步提升其對整體 AI 系統的價值」。
在凱西迪看來，SanDisk 的 NAND 快閃記憶體技術能在合適的成本下實現更高密度，這將有助於其在大型 AI 儲存產品領域中，「維持效能與成本的雙重優勢」。
他預估，SanDisk 於 6 月底展開的 2027 會計年度，資料中心整體營收將達 217 億美元，並在 2028 會計年度進一步增至 286 億美元。
凱西迪給予 SanDisk 目標價 2,400 美元，較該股周二早盤的 1,849.75 美元仍有約 30% 上漲空間。
此外，凱西迪也提到 SanDisk 新推出的商業模式協議，目前已與八家主要 NAND 客戶達成合作。隨著 AI 需求持續造成 NAND 供應短缺，這類多年期合約可讓客戶依特定價格確保供貨。
這些協議將涵蓋 SanDisk 大部分 NAND 產能。凱西迪表示，此舉可望提高需求能見度，並降低 NAND 產業過往常見的景氣循環波動。
paras_en: Amid the AI‑driven surge in memory and storage demand, SanDisk (SNDKV‑US) shares have rocketed this year. As related technologies evolve rapidly, analysts say the company’s business positioning is undergoing a shift.

SanDisk’s NAND flash memory has traditionally been viewed as a bulk storage product, but Rosenblatt analyst Kevin Cassidy noted in his latest report that new‑generation AI systems are creating an opportunity to reposition NAND, turning it from a generic storage item into a more critical component of AI infrastructure.
Cassidy also added SanDisk to his coverage for the first time, assigning a buy rating. NAND flash is a type of non‑volatile memory, meaning it can retain data without continuous power.
He explained that past demand for NAND from PCs, smartphones and other consumer electronics was driven mainly by higher storage density and lower cost per bit.
Storage density refers to the amount of data NAND flash can hold within a given physical space, while cost per bit is the expense of storing each unit of data in a NAND cell.

However, as AI model sizes grow and inference workloads require processing massive data volumes, the market is shifting from chasing the lowest absolute price to placing greater emphasis on density, performance, durability and supply stability. Inference means an AI model makes predictions based on patterns it has learned.

SanDisk’s technology roadmap includes the BiCS8 and BiCS10 architectures co‑developed with Japan’s Kioxia, which stack memory cells vertically to achieve higher capacity in a smaller footprint—an advantage that aligns perfectly with Cassidy’s vision of further enhancing NAND’s value to overall AI systems.
According to Cassidy, SanDisk’s NAND flash can deliver higher density at an acceptable cost, helping it maintain both performance and cost advantages in the large‑scale AI storage market.
He projects that for the fiscal year ending June 30, 2027, SanDisk’s data‑center revenue will reach $21.7 billion, rising to $28.6 billion in fiscal 2028.
Cassidy set a target price of $2,400 for SanDisk, roughly a 30% upside from the stock’s early‑day price of $1,849.75 on Tuesday.

He also noted that SanDisk has recently launched a commercial‑model agreement, already securing deals with eight major NAND customers. As AI demand continues to tighten NAND supply, these multi‑year contracts let customers lock in supply at predetermined prices.
These agreements will cover most of SanDisk’s NAND capacity. Cassidy said the move should improve demand visibility and dampen the cyclical volatility that has historically plagued the NAND industry.

items.title: OpenAI擴大GPT-6產品線 Sol、Luna雙雙降價50%
items.title_en: OpenAI Expands GPT-6 Lineup, Sol and Luna Both Cut Prices by 50%
paras: OpenAI 週二 (22 日) 推出 GPT-6 Sol 與 GPT-6 Luna，進一步擴充 GPT-6 產品線。兩款模型承襲旗艦模型 GPT-6 Astra 的部分能力，API 價格則較 GPT-5.6 Sol 與 Luna 的促銷價降低 50%。
在 GPT-6 系列中，Astra 仍是 OpenAI 處理高難度專案時能力最完整的模型；Sol 與 Luna 則以較低成本滿足不同工作需求。
GPT-6 Sol 主要用於程式設計、工作流程自動化及其他複雜的專業任務；GPT-6 Luna 則適合文件摘要、資訊擷取等工作量大、重複性高且目標明確的任務。
OpenAI 表示，Sol 與 Luna 採用與 Astra 類似的方法訓練，因此承襲 Astra 在推理、事實準確度、程式設計、電腦操作及對齊能力方面的部分進展。
價格方面，GPT-6 Sol 每 100 萬個輸入 token 收費 2 美元，每 100 萬個輸出 token 收費 10 美元，較 GPT-5.6 Sol 的促銷價降低 50%。GPT-6 Luna 每 100 萬個輸入 token 收費 0.1 美元，每 100 萬個輸出 token 收費 0.5 美元，同樣較前一代促銷價減半。
OpenAI 將降價歸因於快取與推論效率提升。GPT-6 可提高提示快取命中率，讓 AI 代理重複利用更多既有內容，縮短回應時間；讀取已快取的輸入 token 時，價格折扣最高可達 90%。
效能方面，GPT-6 Sol 在 AutomationBench 工作流程測試中，以高推理強度執行任務時，表現超越採用最高推理強度的 Claude Opus 5，每項任務成本則僅相當於後者的 9%。
OpenAI 也表示，在根據使用者回報錯誤所進行的事實準確度測試中，GPT-6 Sol 的錯誤數量約為上一代的一半，並在 DeepSWE v1.1 軟體工程基準測試及電腦操作任務中展現更佳表現。
此外，OpenAI 將 Astra 的溝通風格導入 Sol 與 Luna，使兩款模型在技術及程式設計對話中提供更清楚、精簡的回答，並減少術語、不自然措辭及價值較低的細節。兩款模型在對齊測試中，提出誤導性說法的比率也低於 GPT-5.6 系列。
GPT-6 Sol 與 Luna 現已開放 ChatGPT Work 及 Codex 的 Plus、Pro、Business、Enterprise 與 Education 用戶使用；Free 和 Go 用戶可透過桌面版應用程式使用 GPT-6 Luna。兩款模型尚未全面開放一般 ChatGPT 對話使用，OpenAI 將分階段部署，以維持服務穩定。
值得注意的是，OpenAI 此前曾警告，Astra 有時可能嘗試規避人類監督。隨著旗下 AI 代理曾發生進入其他企業系統的事件，外界對先進 AI 模型行為的檢視也持續升高。
GPT-6 Sol 與 Luna 發布前約 90 分鐘，Anthropic 才推出 Claude Opus 5.5，凸顯兩家公司在模型效能與使用成本方面的競爭。
paras_en: OpenAI on Tuesday (the 22nd) launched GPT-6 Sol and GPT-6 Luna, further expanding the GPT-6 product line. Both models inherit some capabilities of the flagship GPT-6 Astra and are priced at 50% lower than the promotional rates for GPT-5.6 Sol and Luna.
Within the GPT-6 series, Astra remains OpenAI’s most capable model for handling high‑difficulty projects, while Sol and Luna provide lower‑cost options for different work needs.

GPT-6 Sol is primarily aimed at programming, workflow automation and other complex professional tasks; GPT-6 Luna is suited for large‑scale, repetitive, well‑defined tasks such as document summarization and information extraction.
OpenAI says Sol and Luna are trained with methods similar to Astra, thus inheriting some of Astra’s advances in reasoning, factual accuracy, coding, computer operation and alignment capabilities.

Pricing: GPT-6 Sol costs $2 per million input tokens and $10 per million output tokens, a 50% reduction from GPT-5.6 Sol’s promotional price. GPT-6 Luna costs $0.1 per million input tokens and $0.5 per million output tokens, also half of the previous generation’s promotional rates.

OpenAI attributes the price cuts to improvements in caching and inference efficiency. GPT-6 can increase prompt‑cache hit rates, allowing AI agents to reuse more existing content and shorten response times; when reading cached input tokens, discounts can reach up to 90%.
In performance tests, GPT-6 Sol outperformed Claude Opus 5 running at the highest inference intensity on the AutomationBench workflow benchmark, with each task costing only about 9% of Claude’s cost.

OpenAI also reports that in factual‑accuracy tests based on user‑reported errors, GPT-6 Sol produced roughly half the errors of the prior generation, and showed better results on the DeepSWE v1.1 software‑engineering benchmark and computer‑operation tasks.

Furthermore, OpenAI has infused Astra’s communication style into Sol and Luna, making the two models give clearer, more concise answers in technical and coding dialogues while reducing jargon, unnatural phrasing and low‑value details. In alignment tests, the rate of misleading statements is lower than in the GPT‑5.6 series.

GPT-6 Sol and Luna are now available to ChatGPT Work and Codex Plus, Pro, Business, Enterprise and Education users; Free and Go users can access GPT-6 Luna via the desktop app. The models are not yet fully open for general ChatGPT conversations, with OpenAI rolling them out in stages to maintain service stability.

It is worth noting that OpenAI previously warned that Astra can sometimes attempt to evade human oversight. As AI agents from the company have previously entered other companies’ systems, external scrutiny of advanced AI model behavior remains heightened.
About 90 minutes before the GPT‑6 Sol and Luna release, Anthropic launched Claude Opus 5.5, highlighting the competition between the two firms on model performance and usage cost.

items.title: 思科跌逾4% Piper Sandler下調目標價 憂成長見頂
items.title_en: Cisco Falls Over 4% as Piper Sandler Cuts Target Price, Concern Growth Peaked
paras: 《CNBC》報導，思科(Cisco)(CSCO-US)股價周二(22日)下跌4.5%，因投行Piper Sandler將這家網路設備供應商的目標價從132美元下調至125美元。
Piper Sandler分析師表示，由於市場擔憂產業成長可能已接近高峰，因此下調對本益比倍數的預期。
思科股價在6月創下歷史新高，過去12個月累計上漲57%，營收也隨著人工智慧熱潮大幅成長。該股周二收在106.44美元。
思科上個月公布強勁的第四季財報，營收達172.5億美元，高於LSEG預估的168億美元，財報表現優於市場預期。
思科在8月最新一次財報電話會議上，針對2027會計年度發布強勁財測，但由於分析師反應冷淡，股價隨後下跌。
思科預估營收將成長近15%，但分析師認為，營收成長率將回落至個位數。Piper Sandler分析師則認為，在市場需求更加強勁的背景下，思科這項預測顯得「保守」。
思科執行長Chuck Robbins上個月受訪時表示，「我們正開始新的一個會計年度。我們正處於非常強勁的市場之中。但這同時是我們將以稍微更加審慎的態度開始新年度的時期。」
超大規模雲端服務商(hyperscaler)在2026會計年度貢獻約40億美元營收，而思科預期這項數字在2027年度將接近翻倍，達到75億美元。
paras_en: CNBC reported that Cisco (CSCO-US) shares fell 4.5% on Tuesday the 22nd after investment bank Piper Sandler lowered the network‑equipment maker’s price target from $132 to $125.
Piper Sandler analysts said the target‑price cut reflects market worries that industry growth may be nearing its peak, prompting a downgrade of the expected price‑to‑earnings multiple.
Cisco’s stock hit an all‑time high in June and has risen 57% over the past 12 months, with revenue surging alongside the AI boom. The shares closed Tuesday at $106.44.
The company posted a strong fourth‑quarter earnings report last month, with revenue of $17.25 billion, beating LSEG’s estimate of $16.8 billion and exceeding market expectations.
In the most recent earnings call in August, Cisco presented a robust outlook for fiscal 2027, but tepid analyst reaction sent the stock lower afterward.

Cisco forecasts revenue growth of nearly 15%, though analysts expect the growth rate to fall back into single‑digit territory. Piper Sandler’s analysts argue that, given stronger market demand, Cisco’s guidance appears "conservative."

CEO Chuck Robbins said in an interview last month, "We are starting a new fiscal year. We are in a very strong market, but it is also a time when we will begin the new year with a slightly more cautious approach."
Hyperscale cloud providers generated about $4 billion of revenue for Cisco in fiscal 2026, and the company expects that figure to almost double to $7.5 billion in fiscal 2027.

items.title: 巴菲特卸任告別信留下「4字箴言」 點破投資市場不敗法則
items.title_en: Buffett Steps Down with a Farewell Letter Containing a “Four‑Word Maxim” that Reveals an Unbeatable Investment Rule
paras: 巴菲特上周五(18日)無預警發布了一封告別信，宣布即刻卸下波克夏(BRK.A-US) 董事長職位，結束長達61年的掌舵生涯。一如既往，這位「奧瑪哈先知」在信中展現其睿智哲理，其中包含了極具震撼力「四字投資箴言」。
以下是巴菲特的談話內容及其對投資人的啟示。
他在信中寫道：「日前，我和親友一同慶祝了我的 96 歲大壽，其中也包括我剛滿一歲的曾孫。現在他的行動速度可是比我快多了。」
隨後，巴菲特宣布卸下自1970年以來擔任的董事長職務，轉任榮譽董事長。他的兒子霍華．巴菲特（Howard Buffett）已在波克夏董事會任職33年，並接任董事長一職。
接著，巴菲特寫下四個發人深省的字，所有投資人都應將其視為一記警鐘：「時間終會勝出。」(Father Time always wins)
一方面，這句話指的是人終將老去；另一方面，這四個字也概括了巴菲特的投資理念。對投資人意味著什麼？「無論在人生或股市，時間終究都是最後贏家。」
巴菲特採取「買進並持有」策略，運用時間與複利，逐步將小額部位轉化為龐大的財富引擎。這項策略讓他成為億萬富豪，也使波克夏成長為市值兆美元級企業。
他也從不避諱公開宣揚這項理念。巴菲特1996年曾表示：「如果你不願意持有一檔股票10年，那就連持有10分鐘都不要考慮。」
另一件未曾改變的事，就是美國股市長期始終走高。過去50年來，標普500指數累計上漲2,100%；若計入股息再投資，總報酬率更達4,530%。難怪巴菲特的名言眾所周知：「我們最喜歡的持有期限是永遠。」
巴菲特並未以「時間終會勝出」作為告別信的結尾。他接著寫道：「然而，時間一直對我十分慷慨，讓我有機會看到波克夏發展到今天這個階段，也讓我對公司的未來比以往任何時候都更有信心。」
回顧標普 500 指數的歷史，很難不對股市的長期走勢抱持信心。即使歷經網路泡沫破裂與經濟大蕭條等重大崩盤，持續留在市場中的投資人，長期仍能獲得可觀報酬，平均表現遠遠勝過頻繁進出的短線客。
因此，即使巴菲特不再擔任波克夏董事長，他的建議與買進持有哲學，在時間的助力下，依然會是贏家。
paras_en: Last Friday (the 18th), Warren Buffett unexpectedly issued a farewell letter announcing that he is stepping down immediately from his role as chairman of Berkshire Hathaway (BRK.A‑US), ending a 61‑year tenure at the helm. As always, the “Oracle of Omaha” displayed his characteristic wisdom in the letter, which includes a striking four‑character investment maxim.
Below is the content of Buffett’s remarks and the insights they offer to investors.
He wrote in the letter: “Recently I celebrated my 96th birthday with family and friends, including my great‑great‑grandson who just turned one. He moves much faster than I do now.”

Buffett then announced that he is relinquishing the chairman position he has held since 1970, becoming honorary chairman. His son Howard Buffett, who has served on Berkshire’s board for 33 years, will assume the chairmanship.
Next, Buffett penned four thought‑provoking words that every investor should take as a warning: “Time always wins.”

On one hand, the phrase points to the fact that people inevitably age; on the other, those four words encapsulate Buffett’s investment philosophy. What does it mean for investors? “Whether in life or in the stock market, time is ultimately the final winner.”

Buffett has employed a “buy‑and‑hold” strategy, using time and compounding to gradually turn modest positions into a massive wealth engine. This approach made him a billionaire and grew Berkshire into a trillion‑dollar‑market‑cap enterprise.
He has never shied away from publicly championing this idea. In 1996, Buffett said, “If you’re not willing to hold a stock for ten years, don’t even think about holding it for ten minutes.”

Another unchanging fact is that the U.S. stock market has risen over the long term. Over the past 50 years the S&P 500 has risen 2,100%; with dividend reinvestment the total return reaches 4,530%. No wonder Buffett’s famous saying is, “Our favorite holding period is forever.”

Buffett did not end his farewell letter with “Time always wins.” He went on to write, “However, time has been very generous to me, giving me the chance to see Berkshire develop to where it is today, and it makes me more confident about the company’s future than ever before.”

Looking back at the history of the S&P 500, it is hard not to feel confident about the market’s long‑term trajectory. Even after major crashes such as the dot‑com bust and the Great Depression, investors who stayed in the market have, over the long run, earned substantial returns, far outperforming frequent short‑term traders.
Therefore, even though Buffett is no longer chairman of Berkshire, his advice and buy‑and‑hold philosophy, bolstered by the power of time, will continue to be a winning approach.

items.title: 高通一次推兩款新手機晶片 聚焦AI代理
items.title_en: Qualcomm Launches Two New Mobile Chips, Focusing on AI Agents
paras: 《Yahoo Finance》報導，高通(Qualcomm)(QCOM-US)周二(22日)在夏威夷茂宜島(Maui)舉行的年度Snapdragon峰會上，推出最新手機晶片。
高通表示，其Snapdragon 8 Elite Extreme Gen 6與Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 6，都是針對智慧代理AI所設計。
高通認為，讓AI代理與AI模型直接在裝置上運行，可以成為一種成本更低的替代方案，讓用戶不必付費透過雲端運行應用程式。
高通行動手機部門資深副總裁暨總經理Chris Patrick在聲明中表示，「今天是一個重要里程碑，我們一次推出兩款全新的旗艦行動平台，帶來即時、個人化且能適應需求的智慧代理AI體驗。」
他補充，「隨著智慧代理AI時代持續發展，我們的雙旗艦策略讓我們能夠突破行動裝置的可能性，同時將最新的AI創新帶給更廣泛的高階裝置。」
高通的手機晶片廣泛應用於全球高階Android裝置，包括小米、Motorola、中興通訊等品牌。
這家行動晶片巨頭正進行大規模轉型，希望降低對智慧型手機市場的依賴，並投入AI資料中心等成長領域。
高通在6月舉行的投資人日活動中，進一步說明了實現這項目標的計畫，公布一系列資料中心元件與伺服器產品，並宣布將2029會紀年度非手機業務營收預測幾乎提高一倍至400億美元。
高通最初開始降低對智慧型手機營收的依賴，是轉向邊緣裝置，包括筆記型電腦、智慧眼鏡以及自動駕駛車輛技術等產品。
不過，智慧型手機相關銷售仍持續推動高通營收。在7月公布的財報中，高通涵蓋智慧型手機、物聯網與汽車業務的CDMA Technologies部門營收，於該季貢獻85億美元，占高通總營收99億美元一大部分。其中，手機業務營收達到51億美元以上，汽車相關業務營收則達到15億美元。
高通股價周二上漲2.08%，至每股198.27美元。
paras_en: Yahoo Finance reported that Qualcomm (QCOM-US) on Tuesday the 22nd held its annual Snapdragon Summit on Maui, Hawaii, where it unveiled its latest mobile chips.
Qualcomm said its Snapdragon 8 Elite Extreme Gen 6 and Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 6 are both designed for smart‑agent AI.
Qualcomm believes that running AI agents and models directly on devices can be a lower‑cost alternative, letting users avoid paying for cloud‑based application execution.

Chris Patrick, senior vice president and general manager of Qualcomm’s mobile phone division, said in a statement, "Today is a major milestone – we are launching two brand‑new flagship mobile platforms that deliver real‑time, personalized, demand‑adaptive smart‑agent AI experiences."

He added, "As the era of smart‑agent AI continues to evolve, our dual‑flagship strategy enables us to push the boundaries of mobile devices while bringing the latest AI innovations to a broader range of premium devices."
Qualcomm’s mobile chips are widely used in high‑end Android devices worldwide, including brands such as Xiaomi, Motorola and ZTE.
The mobile‑chip giant is undergoing a large‑scale transformation, aiming to reduce its reliance on the smartphone market and invest in growth areas such as AI data centers.

At its investor day in June, Qualcomm further outlined its plan to achieve this goal, unveiling a suite of data‑center components and server products and announcing that its non‑phone revenue forecast for 2029 would almost double to $40 billion.
Qualcomm initially began reducing its dependence on smartphone revenue by shifting toward edge devices, including laptops, smart glasses and autonomous‑vehicle technologies.

Nevertheless, smartphone‑related sales continue to drive Qualcomm’s revenue. In its July earnings release, the CDMA Technologies segment covering smartphones, IoT and automotive contributed $8.5 billion that quarter, a large share of Qualcomm’s total $9.9 billion revenue, with mobile business revenue exceeding $5.1 billion and automotive‑related revenue reaching $1.5 billion.
Qualcomm’s stock rose 2.08% on Tuesday to $198.27 per share.

items.title: 馬斯克、黃仁勳與庫克赴宴見習近平 一文看懂他們對中國的訴求
items.title_en: Musk, Huang and Cook Attend Dinner with Xi: Understanding Their Demands on China
paras: 馬斯克每年有近 210 億美元的特斯拉營收來自中國；蘋果(AAPL-US) 上一年度在大中華區的營收超過 640 億美元；輝達(NVDA-US) 有價值數十億美元的晶片難以在中國銷售；花旗集團(C-US) 則仍在等待北京批准其早在 2021 年便申請設立的證券業務。
這些企業的代表周四(24日)預計將與中國國家主席習近平共進晚宴。
馬斯克、輝達執行長黃仁勳、花旗執行長范潔恩（Jane Fraser），以及蘋果執行董事長庫克（Tim Cook），都在白宮為習近平舉行國宴的受邀企業領袖之列。亞馬遜(AMZN-US) 創辦人貝佐斯、谷歌(GOOGL-US)執行長皮查伊、OpenAI 執行長奧特曼，以及及戴爾科技(DELL-US) 執行長戴爾預計也將出席。
這場晚宴正值習近平訪問美國之際，預料雙方將就貿易、稀土與人工智慧等議題展開會談。然而，對在座的企業高層而言，他們關切的問題更為具體。
美中貿易全國委員會會長史坦（Sean Stein）近日表示：「中國已成為這些企業公司基因與商業生態系的重要一環。」該委員會最新調查顯示，95% 受訪美國企業認為，中國對其全球競爭力至少具有一定程度的重要性。
特斯拉：中國營收近210億美元 市占卻持續下滑
很少有企業比特斯拉(TSLA-US) 更能說明這一點。
這家電動車大廠在2025 年在中國創造 209.6 億美元營收，約佔其全球總營收的22%。然而，市場競爭已日益白熱化：隨著本土競爭者急起直追，特斯拉在中國純電動車市場的市佔率，已從2020年的15%以上滑落至第二季的6.6%。
對馬斯克而言，維持可預測的競爭環境就相當重要。特斯拉上海工廠仍是關鍵生產與出口基地，而中國監管機關對特斯拉能否在這個美國以外最大市場自由營運，也具有重大影響力。
輝達：晶片有買家 美中監管成銷售雙重關卡
黃仁勳則面臨不同的難題：輝達在中國有渴望其晶片的客戶，但要促成這些交易卻變得益發繁複。
美國出口管制迫使輝達去年針對中國市場的 H20 處理器認列 45 億美元費用。華府此後已允許向部分中國客戶有限度出貨較新的 H200 晶片，但輝達表示，中國方面的限制使其無法售出許可範圍內的全部晶片。
在這項計畫下，H200 銷售額占輝達最近一季資料中心營收不到 1%。
這意味著黃仁勳必須同時取得美中兩國政府批准：華府須允許輝達出貨晶片，北京也須允許中國企業採購。
蘋果：中國既是重要市場 也是關鍵生產基地
相較之下，蘋果面臨的中國曝險則更加廣泛。
蘋果 2025 會計年度在大中華區的銷售額達 644 億美元，約占全球營收的 15%。儘管蘋果正將更多產能轉移至印度、越南等國，中國在其製造供應鏈中依舊盤根錯節。
北京當局不僅能影響蘋果的銷售品項，也能左右其生產基地。蘋果智慧功能（Apple Intelligence）直到今年7月才在中國取得登記核准，並由阿里巴巴與百度協助蘋果符合中國針對生成式AI的法規要求。
花旗：等待北京點頭 全資證券公司最快本月獲准
至於范潔恩，願望清單上的目標更加具體。
花旗正在等待中國核准其全資證券公司。該行已於 2021 年提出申請，最快可能在本月取得牌照。獲准後，花旗計劃將該部門人力擴增近一倍，達到約 100 人。
這份賓客名單也再次顯示，全球兩大經濟體要彼此脫鉤有多麼困難。
谷歌的皮查伊與OpenAI的奧特曼對中國銷售的直接依賴雖較低，但在整體的雙邊關係中仍牽動重大利益。
中美正展開 AI 競賽，中國開發商已迅速縮小與美國模型的差距，兩國政府同時也在研判，究竟應允許多少技術，尤其是先進運算能力跨越太平洋流通。
AI 預料將成為峰會討論重點之一。
這種依賴關係並非單向。中國政府預計也將帶著自身商業利益前往華府，而中國企業仍面臨美國關稅、投資限制及科技管制。
不過，這份美方賓客名單仍清楚反映，要拆解全球兩大經濟體之間的連結何其困難。
對即將與習近平共進晚宴的企業高層而言，中國既可能是客戶、生產基地、監管者，也可能是競爭對手，有時甚至同時扮演所有角色。
paras_en: Musk derives nearly $21 billion of Tesla’s annual revenue from China; Apple (AAPL-US) posted over $64 billion in revenue in Greater China last year; Nvidia (NVDA-US) has chip assets worth billions that are hard to sell in China; and Citigroup (C-US) is still awaiting Beijing’s approval of a securities business it applied for back in 2021.
The representatives of these firms are expected to dine with Chinese President Xi Jinping on Thursday (the 24th).

Musk, Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang, Citigroup CEO Jane Fraser, and Apple executive chairman Tim Cook are among the invited corporate leaders for the state dinner for Xi at the White House. Amazon (AMZN-US) founder Jeff Bezos, Google (GOOGL-US) CEO Sundar Pichai, OpenAI CEO Sam Altman, and Dell Technologies (DELL-US) CEO Michael Dell are also slated to attend.

The dinner coincides with Xi’s visit to the United States, and the two sides are expected to discuss trade, rare earths and artificial intelligence. Yet the executives present have more concrete concerns of their own.

Sean Stein, chair of the US‑China Trade National Committee, recently said: “China has become an essential part of these companies’ DNA and business ecosystems.” The committee’s latest survey shows 95 % of surveyed US firms view China as at least somewhat important to their global competitiveness.
Tesla: About $21 billion in China revenue but market share keeps falling
Few companies illustrate this better than Tesla (TSLA‑US).

The electric‑vehicle maker is projected to generate $20.96 billion in China in 2025, roughly 22 % of its total global revenue. However competition has intensified: as domestic rivals close the gap, Tesla’s share of China’s pure‑EV market has slipped from over 15 % in 2020 to 6.6 % in the second quarter.

For Musk, a predictable competitive environment is crucial. Tesla’s Shanghai plant remains a key production and export hub, and Chinese regulators’ stance on whether Tesla can operate freely in its largest market outside the US carries huge weight.
Nvidia: Chips have buyers, US‑China regulation creates a double hurdle
Jensen Huang faces a different dilemma: Nvidia has eager customers for its chips in China, but closing those deals has become increasingly complex.

U.S. export controls forced Nvidia to record a $4.5 billion expense last year for its H20 processor aimed at the Chinese market. Washington later allowed limited shipments of the newer H200 chip to some Chinese customers, but Nvidia says Chinese restrictions prevent it from selling the full range of chips it is permitted to ship.
Under this program, H200 sales account for less than 1 % of Nvidia’s most recent quarter’s data‑center revenue.
That means Huang must secure approvals from both governments: Washington must allow Nvidia to ship the chips, and Beijing must permit Chinese firms to buy them.
Apple: China is both a key market and a critical manufacturing base
By contrast, Apple’s exposure to China is broader.

Apple’s fiscal 2025 sales in Greater China are projected at $64.4 billion, about 15 % of its global revenue. Although Apple is shifting more capacity to India, Vietnam and other countries, China remains deeply embedded in its manufacturing supply chain.

Beijing authorities can influence not only Apple’s product sales but also its production sites. Apple Intelligence only received registration approval in China in July this year, with Alibaba and Baidu helping Apple meet Chinese regulations on generative AI.
Citigroup: Awaiting Beijing’s nod, a wholly‑owned securities firm could be approved this month
For Jane Fraser, the wish list is more concrete.

Citigroup is waiting for Chinese approval of its wholly‑owned securities subsidiary. The bank filed the application in 2021 and could obtain the licence as early as this month. Once approved, Citigroup plans to nearly double the unit’s staff to about 100 people.
The guest list again underscores how difficult it would be for the world’s two largest economies to decouple.
Google’s Pichai and OpenAI’s Altman have relatively low direct dependence on Chinese sales, yet they still touch significant interests in the broader bilateral relationship.

The US and China are locked in an AI race; Chinese developers have rapidly closed the gap with US models, and both governments are weighing how much technology—especially advanced computing power—should be allowed to flow across the Pacific.
AI is expected to be a major topic of discussion at the summit.

The dependence is not one‑way. The Chinese government is also expected to bring its own commercial interests to Washington, while Chinese firms continue to face US tariffs, investment limits and tech controls.
Nevertheless, the US side’s guest list makes clear how hard it is to untangle the connections between the two economic giants.
For the senior executives about to dine with Xi, China can be a customer, a manufacturing base, a regulator, a competitor, and sometimes all of these roles simultaneously.

items.title: 〈紐約匯市〉美元徘徊近8周高點 Fed官員強調通膨風險
items.title_en: <New York FX> Dollar Hovers Near 8-Week High as Fed Officials Emphasize Inflation Risks
paras: 美元周二(22日)上漲，延續上周聯準會(Fed)升息帶來的提振。歐元則在疲軟的消費者信心數據公布後走低。
紐約尾盤，追蹤美元兌六種主要貨幣的美元指數(DXY)上漲0.1%，報100.54，創7月29日以來最高。
聯邦公開市場委員會(FOMC)上周三一致投票決定，將聯邦資金利率從3.50%-3.75%上調至3.75%-4.00%。此外，聯準會更新的經濟預測摘要顯示，至少有12名FOMC成員預期今年還會再升息一次，而聯準會主席華許(Kevin Warsh)在決策後記者會上也明顯釋出鷹派訊號。
較高的利率環境通常有利於美元走強。自聯準會升息以來，美元已上漲近1%。
波士頓聯準銀行總裁柯林斯(Susan Collins)周二再次表示支持FOMC 的決定。她在社群媒體貼文中強調，偏高的價格壓力要求採取更具限制性的政策立場，以實現長期物價穩定。
她表示，近期經濟指標顯示，在成本持續偏高超過五年後，未來出現「通膨明顯高於2%」情境的可能性有所增加。
另外，里奇蒙聯準銀行總裁巴金(Tom Barkin)也支持FOMC的升息決定，並表示，目前通膨風險高於充分就業所面臨的風險。
油價成為市場焦點
本月一大主題，就是因能源推動的價格壓力而進行的央行升息，歐洲央行(ECB)與日本銀行(BoJ)也都在收緊貨幣政策。在此背景下，近期油價持續下跌，已引起外匯市場參與者關注。
原油基準價格已連續五個交易日下跌，原因包括市場對供應中斷的擔憂有所緩解，以及對中東外交取得進展的期待。交易員對沙烏地阿拉伯採取果斷措施感到振奮，以抵消一條重要管線關閉所造成的影響，該管線是在與伊朗支持的葉門武裝組織「青年運動」(Houthis)衝突擴大期間受損。
美國總統川普本周在聯合國大會期間，可能與伊朗代表團，包括外交部長及總統會面的可能性，也改善了市場情緒。川普周二在聯合國發表演講時表示，他認為華府與德黑蘭之間的協議將在即將於11月舉行的美國期中選舉後達成。
Macquarie全球外匯與利率策略師Thierry Wizman表示，「本周發生的事情可能成為決定原油價格中期走向的關鍵。因為美伊戰爭的關鍵參與者將從今天開始在紐約舉行會談。而這些會談所達成的協議與共識，可能決定戰爭是否持續並升級，或是否能找到退出衝突的途徑。」
他指出，「原油價格的走向仍會影響全球通膨，以及各國央行對此所採取的決策。我們已看到每家主要央行(包括美國聯準會)都提到能源價格或『地緣政治』是未來決策的一項驅動因素。這也是近期『鷹派』言論背後的關鍵原因。」
Wizman補充，「我們仍將較高的油價與美元兌主要貨幣走強聯繫在一起。這並不是因為高油價會導致聯準會升息，如果油價進一步上漲，所有央行都會轉鷹。原因在於，美國經濟成長與美元會透過貿易條件改善及實質所得效應，從高油價中受益。我們認為，美伊戰爭透過讓原油價格維持高檔，已成為今年支撐美元強勢的重要因素。」
歐元走弱 日元小幅走低
歐元兌美元下跌0.2%，至1.1448 美元。稍早公布數據顯示，歐元區9月消費者信心較8月轉弱，此前已連續四個月回升。
另一方面，日本銀行上周升息後，日元一度加速貶值，如今跌勢暫歇，匯價變化不大。美元兌日元略高於持平水準，報157.38。
由於日本正在放連續假期，亞洲交易部門成交量偏低。外匯配置機構警告，這種季節性交易低迷可能大幅放大市場波動，以及央行行動所帶來的影響。
《日本經濟新聞》報導，日銀已與外匯交易部門進行正式的「匯率詢價」，引發市場焦慮升溫。此程序是指央行官員致電商業銀行，詢問即時可執行的匯率報價。
儘管日元在日銀非一致決議升息25個基點後持續走弱，使借貸成本升至31年高點，但市場策略師指出，東京擁有龐大的政策火力。日本持有估計約1兆美元的外匯存底，為當局提供充足的流動性。

paras_en: The dollar rose on Tuesday (the 22nd), continuing the boost from the Fed’s rate hike last week. The euro fell after weak consumer‑confidence data were released.
In the New York close, the dollar index (DXY), which tracks the greenback against six major currencies, rose 0.1% to 100.54, its highest level since July 29.

The Federal Open Market Committee (FOMC) voted unanimously last Wednesday to raise the federal funds rate range from 3.50‑3.75% to 3.75‑4.00%. In addition, the Fed’s updated economic outlook summary showed that at least 12 FOMC members expect another rate hike this year, and Fed Chair Kevin Warsh sent a clear hawkish signal at the post‑decision press conference.
Higher‑rate environments generally favor a stronger dollar. Since the Fed’s hike, the dollar has gained nearly 1%.

Boston Fed President Susan Collins reiterated her support for the FOMC’s decision on Tuesday. In a social‑media post she stressed that elevated price pressures call for a more restrictive policy stance to achieve long‑term price stability.
She added that recent economic indicators suggest that after more than five years of persistently high costs, the likelihood of a scenario where “inflation is clearly above 2%” has increased.
Richmond Fed President Tom Barkin also backed the FOMC’s rate‑rise decision, noting that current inflation risks are higher than the risks posed by full employment.
Oil prices become a market focus

A major theme this month is central‑bank tightening driven by energy‑related price pressures, with both the European Central Bank (ECB) and the Bank of Japan (BoJ) tightening policy. Against this backdrop, recent declines in oil prices have drawn attention from FX market participants.

Benchmark crude has fallen for five consecutive trading days, driven by easing concerns over supply disruptions and hopes for progress in Middle‑East diplomacy. Traders were encouraged by Saudi Arabia’s decisive actions to offset the impact of a key pipeline closure that was damaged during the expanded conflict with Iran‑backed Yemeni Houthi forces.

U.S. President Donald Trump’s possible meeting with the Iranian delegation, including its foreign minister and president, during the United Nations General Assembly this week has also lifted market sentiment. In a speech at the UN on Tuesday, Trump said he believes an agreement between Washington and Tehran will be reached after the U.S. mid‑term elections in November.

Macquarie global FX and rates strategist Thierry Wizman said, “What’s happening this week could be pivotal for the medium‑term direction of crude prices, because the key players in the U.S.–Iran conflict will start talks in New York today. The agreements and consensus reached in those talks could determine whether the war escalates or a path out of the conflict is found.”

He noted, “The trajectory of oil prices will continue to affect global inflation and the policy choices of central banks. We have seen every major central bank (including the Fed) cite energy prices or ‘geopolitics’ as a driver for future decisions. That is the underlying reason for the recent hawkish rhetoric.”

Wizman added, “We still link higher oil prices with a stronger dollar against major currencies. This is not because high oil prices would force the Fed to hike rates; if oil rises further, all central banks would turn hawkish. The reason is that U.S. economic growth and the dollar benefit from improved trade terms and real‑income effects from higher oil prices. We believe the U.S.–Iran conflict, by keeping crude prices elevated, has become a key factor supporting the dollar’s strength this year.”
Euro weakens, yen slips slightly
The euro fell 0.2% against the dollar to $1.1448. Earlier data showed Euro‑area consumer confidence for September weakened from August, ending a four‑month streak of improvement.

On the other hand, after the Bank of Japan’s rate hike last week, the yen briefly accelerated its depreciation but has now paused, with little change in the exchange rate. The dollar/yen is slightly above the flat level at 157.38.

Because Japan is entering a continuous holiday period, Asian trading volumes are low. FX allocation firms warn that this seasonal lull can amplify market volatility and the impact of central‑bank actions.

The Nikkei reported that the BOJ has conducted a formal “exchange‑rate inquiry” with the FX trading desk, heightening market anxiety. The procedure involves central‑bank officials calling commercial banks to request real‑time executable rate quotes.

Although the yen has continued to weaken after the BOJ’s non‑consensus 25‑basis‑point hike, pushing borrowing costs to a 31‑year high, market strategists point out that Tokyo still wields massive policy firepower. Japan holds roughly $1 trillion in foreign‑exchange reserves, providing ample liquidity to authorities.

items.title: 川普支持禁止柴油出口 稱很快會做出決定！
items.title_en: Trump Supports Banning Diesel Exports, Says Decision Will Be Made Soon!
paras: 多家外媒報導，美國柴油價格創下歷史新高，川普政府正評估禁止柴油出口，試圖緩解美國物價壓力。美國總統川普週二 (22 日) 表示，已向幕僚提出停止出口柴油，政府將很快決定是否採取行動。財政部長貝森特同日表示，官員仍須評估美國整體煉油產能，以及全面或部分禁令能否奏效。
川普週二 (22 日) 在紐約出席聯合國大會期間，與烏克蘭總統澤倫斯基會面時向記者表示，美國生產大量柴油，他已要求幕僚考慮停止出口。
被問及何時決定是否實施禁令，川普透露，他很快會做出決定，無論結果如何。
貝森特在同一場合表示，政府正在檢視柴油出口禁令是否可行，評估範圍包括整體煉油產能，以及「全面禁止」出口與「部分限制」出口，各自能否達到預期效果。
目前政府尚未宣布禁令或具體實施方式。
柴油漲價使川普面臨來自共和黨內的壓力。
包括愛荷華州參議員葛拉斯里在內的共和黨議員，因農民及卡車司機承受高油價，已呼籲政府禁止柴油出口。
參議院多數黨領袖圖恩也對價格上漲表示關切。11 月期中選舉即將到來，燃料價格成為政府必須面對的問題。
根據美國汽車協會 (AAA) 數據，全美柴油平均價格已升至每加侖 6.53 美元，較一週前的 6.27 美元上漲 0.26 美元，也比去年同期的 3.69 美元高出 2.84 美元。加州柴油價格更達每加侖 8.44 美元。
供應面上，東歐與中東戰事削減全球煉油產能。烏克蘭攻擊俄羅斯煉油廠後，俄羅斯實施柴油出口禁令；中東煉油廠也遭伊朗及其盟友攻擊，伊朗對油輪的威脅則限制成品油經荷姆茲海峽出口。面對全球供應缺口及高利潤率，美國煉油業者增加柴油出口。
不過，禁止出口能否持續壓低美國柴油價格，仍有疑問。
受訪專家認為，禁令或許能在短期內緩解本土能源價格，但長期後果可能相當嚴重。
CIBC Private Wealth 資深能源交易員兼董事總經理 Rebecca Babin 指出，限制出口對美國煉油業者將十分不利，也會推高全球能源價格。由於美國仍須進口部分所需燃料及原油產品，全球價格上漲最終也可能波及美國市場。
paras_en: Multiple foreign media outlets report that U.S. diesel prices have hit historic highs, and the Trump administration is evaluating a ban on diesel exports in an effort to ease domestic price pressure. President Donald Trump said on Tuesday (the 22nd) that he has asked his staff to consider halting diesel shipments and that the government will decide soon whether to act. Treasury Secretary Steven Mnuchin said the same day that officials still need to assess overall U.S. refining capacity and whether a full or partial ban would be effective.

Trump, while attending the United Nations General Assembly in New York on Tuesday (the 22nd), told reporters during a meeting with Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky that the United States produces a large amount of diesel and that he has asked his staff to consider stopping its export.
When asked when a decision on the ban would be made, Trump disclosed that he will decide soon, regardless of the outcome.

Mnuchin said at the same event that the government is reviewing the feasibility of a diesel export ban, examining overall refining capacity and whether a "total prohibition" or a "partial restriction" would achieve the desired effect.
The administration has not yet announced any ban or specific implementation method.
Rising diesel prices are putting pressure on Trump from within the Republican Party.
Republican lawmakers, including Iowa Senator Chuck Grassley, have called for a ban on diesel exports as farmers and truck drivers bear the burden of high fuel costs.
Senate Majority Leader Mitch McConnell also expressed concern over the price hikes. With the November midterm elections approaching, fuel prices have become a pressing issue for the government.

According to data from the American Automobile Association (AAA), the average diesel price nationwide has risen to $6.53 per gallon, up $0.26 from $6.27 a week ago and $2.84 higher than the $3.69 average a year ago. In California, diesel prices have reached $8.44 per gallon.

On the supply side, the war in Eastern Europe and the Middle East has cut global refining capacity. After Ukraine attacked Russian refineries, Russia imposed a diesel export ban; Middle‑East refineries have also been hit by attacks from Iran and its allies, and Iranian threats to oil tankers have limited product exports through the Hormuz Strait. Facing a global supply gap and high profit margins, U.S. refiners have increased diesel shipments abroad.
However, it remains uncertain whether an export ban would sustainably keep U.S. diesel prices low.
Experts interviewed say a ban might provide short‑term relief for domestic energy prices, but the long‑term consequences could be quite severe.

Rebecca Babin, a senior energy trader and managing director at CIBC Private Wealth, warned that restricting exports would be very detrimental to U.S. refiners and would push up global energy prices. Because the United States still needs to import some fuel and crude products, higher global prices could ultimately spill over into the U.S. market.

items.title_en: NAND Is No Longer Just a Storage Commodity – SanDisk’s Target Price Hits $2,400, Still Up 30%
paras: 在人工智慧（AI）帶動記憶體與儲存需求激增下，SanDisk(SNDKV-US) 股價今年大幅飆升。隨著相關技術快速發展，分析師認為，該公司的業務定位正迎來轉變。
SanDisk 的 NAND 快閃記憶體過去通常被視為大宗儲存產品，但 Rosenblatt 分析師凱西迪（Kevin Cassidy）在最新報告中指出，新一代 AI 系統正為 NAND 創造重新定位的機會，使其從一般儲存產品轉變為 AI 基礎設施中更關鍵的系統元件。
凱西迪也首次將 SanDisk 納入追蹤研究，給予買進評等。NAND 快閃記憶體屬於非揮發性記憶體，這意味著它能在無須持續供電的情況下保存資料。
凱西迪表示，過去個人電腦、智慧手機及其他消費電子產品對 NAND 的需求，主要由儲存密度提升與每位元成本下降所驅動。
儲存密度是指 NAND 快閃記憶體在一定實體空間內可容納的資料量，每位元成本則是 NAND 記憶單元儲存每單位資料的成本。
不過，隨著 AI 模型規模擴大，加上推論程序需要處理大量資料，市場考量正從追求最低絕對價格，逐漸轉向更重視儲存密度、效能、耐用度及供應穩定性。所謂推論，是指 AI 模型依據已學習的模式進行預測。
SanDisk 的技術藍圖涵蓋與日本鎧俠（Kioxia）共同開發的 BiCS8 與 BiCS10 架構，透過垂直堆疊記憶體單元，在更小的空間內實現更高儲存容量，這項優勢完美呼應了凱西迪所看好的願景，將使 NAND 「進一步提升其對整體 AI 系統的價值」。
在凱西迪看來，SanDisk 的 NAND 快閃記憶體技術能在合適的成本下實現更高密度，這將有助於其在大型 AI 儲存產品領域中，「維持效能與成本的雙重優勢」。
他預估，SanDisk 於 6 月底展開的 2027 會計年度，資料中心整體營收將達 217 億美元，並在 2028 會計年度進一步增至 286 億美元。
凱西迪給予 SanDisk 目標價 2,400 美元，較該股周二早盤的 1,849.75 美元仍有約 30% 上漲空間。
此外，凱西迪也提到 SanDisk 新推出的商業模式協議，目前已與八家主要 NAND 客戶達成合作。隨著 AI 需求持續造成 NAND 供應短缺，這類多年期合約可讓客戶依特定價格確保供貨。
這些協議將涵蓋 SanDisk 大部分 NAND 產能。凱西迪表示，此舉可望提高需求能見度，並降低 NAND 產業過往常見的景氣循環波動。
paras_en: Amid the AI‑driven surge in memory and storage demand, SanDisk (SNDKV‑US) shares have rocketed this year. As related technologies evolve rapidly, analysts say the company’s business positioning is undergoing a shift.

SanDisk’s NAND flash memory has traditionally been viewed as a bulk storage product, but Rosenblatt analyst Kevin Cassidy noted in his latest report that new‑generation AI systems are creating an opportunity to reposition NAND, turning it from a generic storage item into a more critical component of AI infrastructure.
Cassidy also added SanDisk to his coverage for the first time, assigning a buy rating. NAND flash is a type of non‑volatile memory, meaning it can retain data without continuous power.
He explained that past demand for NAND from PCs, smartphones and other consumer electronics was driven mainly by higher storage density and lower cost per bit.
Storage density refers to the amount of data NAND flash can hold within a given physical space, while cost per bit is the expense of storing each unit of data in a NAND cell.

However, as AI model sizes grow and inference workloads require processing massive data volumes, the market is shifting from chasing the lowest absolute price to placing greater emphasis on density, performance, durability and supply stability. Inference means an AI model makes predictions based on patterns it has learned.

SanDisk’s technology roadmap includes the BiCS8 and BiCS10 architectures co‑developed with Japan’s Kioxia, which stack memory cells vertically to achieve higher capacity in a smaller footprint—an advantage that aligns perfectly with Cassidy’s vision of further enhancing NAND’s value to overall AI systems.
According to Cassidy, SanDisk’s NAND flash can deliver higher density at an acceptable cost, helping it maintain both performance and cost advantages in the large‑scale AI storage market.
He projects that for the fiscal year ending June 30, 2027, SanDisk’s data‑center revenue will reach $21.7 billion, rising to $28.6 billion in fiscal 2028.
Cassidy set a target price of $2,400 for SanDisk, roughly a 30% upside from the stock’s early‑day price of $1,849.75 on Tuesday.

He also noted that SanDisk has recently launched a commercial‑model agreement, already securing deals with eight major NAND customers. As AI demand continues to tighten NAND supply, these multi‑year contracts let customers lock in supply at predetermined prices.
These agreements will cover most of SanDisk’s NAND capacity. Cassidy said the move should improve demand visibility and dampen the cyclical volatility that has historically plagued the NAND industry.

items.title: OpenAI擴大GPT-6產品線 Sol、Luna雙雙降價50%
items.title_en: OpenAI Expands GPT-6 Lineup, Sol and Luna Both Cut Prices by 50%
paras: OpenAI 週二 (22 日) 推出 GPT-6 Sol 與 GPT-6 Luna，進一步擴充 GPT-6 產品線。兩款模型承襲旗艦模型 GPT-6 Astra 的部分能力，API 價格則較 GPT-5.6 Sol 與 Luna 的促銷價降低 50%。
在 GPT-6 系列中，Astra 仍是 OpenAI 處理高難度專案時能力最完整的模型；Sol 與 Luna 則以較低成本滿足不同工作需求。
GPT-6 Sol 主要用於程式設計、工作流程自動化及其他複雜的專業任務；GPT-6 Luna 則適合文件摘要、資訊擷取等工作量大、重複性高且目標明確的任務。
OpenAI 表示，Sol 與 Luna 採用與 Astra 類似的方法訓練，因此承襲 Astra 在推理、事實準確度、程式設計、電腦操作及對齊能力方面的部分進展。
價格方面，GPT-6 Sol 每 100 萬個輸入 token 收費 2 美元，每 100 萬個輸出 token 收費 10 美元，較 GPT-5.6 Sol 的促銷價降低 50%。GPT-6 Luna 每 100 萬個輸入 token 收費 0.1 美元，每 100 萬個輸出 token 收費 0.5 美元，同樣較前一代促銷價減半。
OpenAI 將降價歸因於快取與推論效率提升。GPT-6 可提高提示快取命中率，讓 AI 代理重複利用更多既有內容，縮短回應時間；讀取已快取的輸入 token 時，價格折扣最高可達 90%。
效能方面，GPT-6 Sol 在 AutomationBench 工作流程測試中，以高推理強度執行任務時，表現超越採用最高推理強度的 Claude Opus 5，每項任務成本則僅相當於後者的 9%。
OpenAI 也表示，在根據使用者回報錯誤所進行的事實準確度測試中，GPT-6 Sol 的錯誤數量約為上一代的一半，並在 DeepSWE v1.1 軟體工程基準測試及電腦操作任務中展現更佳表現。
此外，OpenAI 將 Astra 的溝通風格導入 Sol 與 Luna，使兩款模型在技術及程式設計對話中提供更清楚、精簡的回答，並減少術語、不自然措辭及價值較低的細節。兩款模型在對齊測試中，提出誤導性說法的比率也低於 GPT-5.6 系列。
GPT-6 Sol 與 Luna 現已開放 ChatGPT Work 及 Codex 的 Plus、Pro、Business、Enterprise 與 Education 用戶使用；Free 和 Go 用戶可透過桌面版應用程式使用 GPT-6 Luna。兩款模型尚未全面開放一般 ChatGPT 對話使用，OpenAI 將分階段部署，以維持服務穩定。
值得注意的是，OpenAI 此前曾警告，Astra 有時可能嘗試規避人類監督。隨著旗下 AI 代理曾發生進入其他企業系統的事件，外界對先進 AI 模型行為的檢視也持續升高。
GPT-6 Sol 與 Luna 發布前約 90 分鐘，Anthropic 才推出 Claude Opus 5.5，凸顯兩家公司在模型效能與使用成本方面的競爭。
paras_en: OpenAI on Tuesday (the 22nd) launched GPT-6 Sol and GPT-6 Luna, further expanding the GPT-6 product line. Both models inherit some capabilities of the flagship GPT-6 Astra and are priced at 50% lower than the promotional rates for GPT-5.6 Sol and Luna.
Within the GPT-6 series, Astra remains OpenAI’s most capable model for handling high‑difficulty projects, while Sol and Luna provide lower‑cost options for different work needs.

GPT-6 Sol is primarily aimed at programming, workflow automation and other complex professional tasks; GPT-6 Luna is suited for large‑scale, repetitive, well‑defined tasks such as document summarization and information extraction.
OpenAI says Sol and Luna are trained with methods similar to Astra, thus inheriting some of Astra’s advances in reasoning, factual accuracy, coding, computer operation and alignment capabilities.

Pricing: GPT-6 Sol costs $2 per million input tokens and $10 per million output tokens, a 50% reduction from GPT-5.6 Sol’s promotional price. GPT-6 Luna costs $0.1 per million input tokens and $0.5 per million output tokens, also half of the previous generation’s promotional rates.

OpenAI attributes the price cuts to improvements in caching and inference efficiency. GPT-6 can increase prompt‑cache hit rates, allowing AI agents to reuse more existing content and shorten response times; when reading cached input tokens, discounts can reach up to 90%.
In performance tests, GPT-6 Sol outperformed Claude Opus 5 running at the highest inference intensity on the AutomationBench workflow benchmark, with each task costing only about 9% of Claude’s cost.

OpenAI also reports that in factual‑accuracy tests based on user‑reported errors, GPT-6 Sol produced roughly half the errors of the prior generation, and showed better results on the DeepSWE v1.1 software‑engineering benchmark and computer‑operation tasks.

Furthermore, OpenAI has infused Astra’s communication style into Sol and Luna, making the two models give clearer, more concise answers in technical and coding dialogues while reducing jargon, unnatural phrasing and low‑value details. In alignment tests, the rate of misleading statements is lower than in the GPT‑5.6 series.

GPT-6 Sol and Luna are now available to ChatGPT Work and Codex Plus, Pro, Business, Enterprise and Education users; Free and Go users can access GPT-6 Luna via the desktop app. The models are not yet fully open for general ChatGPT conversations, with OpenAI rolling them out in stages to maintain service stability.

It is worth noting that OpenAI previously warned that Astra can sometimes attempt to evade human oversight. As AI agents from the company have previously entered other companies’ systems, external scrutiny of advanced AI model behavior remains heightened.
About 90 minutes before the GPT‑6 Sol and Luna release, Anthropic launched Claude Opus 5.5, highlighting the competition between the two firms on model performance and usage cost.

items.title: 思科跌逾4% Piper Sandler下調目標價 憂成長見頂
items.title_en: Cisco Falls Over 4% as Piper Sandler Cuts Target Price, Concern Growth Peaked
paras: 《CNBC》報導，思科(Cisco)(CSCO-US)股價周二(22日)下跌4.5%，因投行Piper Sandler將這家網路設備供應商的目標價從132美元下調至125美元。
Piper Sandler分析師表示，由於市場擔憂產業成長可能已接近高峰，因此下調對本益比倍數的預期。
思科股價在6月創下歷史新高，過去12個月累計上漲57%，營收也隨著人工智慧熱潮大幅成長。該股周二收在106.44美元。
思科上個月公布強勁的第四季財報，營收達172.5億美元，高於LSEG預估的168億美元，財報表現優於市場預期。
思科在8月最新一次財報電話會議上，針對2027會計年度發布強勁財測，但由於分析師反應冷淡，股價隨後下跌。
思科預估營收將成長近15%，但分析師認為，營收成長率將回落至個位數。Piper Sandler分析師則認為，在市場需求更加強勁的背景下，思科這項預測顯得「保守」。
思科執行長Chuck Robbins上個月受訪時表示，「我們正開始新的一個會計年度。我們正處於非常強勁的市場之中。但這同時是我們將以稍微更加審慎的態度開始新年度的時期。」
超大規模雲端服務商(hyperscaler)在2026會計年度貢獻約40億美元營收，而思科預期這項數字在2027年度將接近翻倍，達到75億美元。
paras_en: CNBC reported that Cisco (CSCO-US) shares fell 4.5% on Tuesday the 22nd after investment bank Piper Sandler lowered the network‑equipment maker’s price target from $132 to $125.
Piper Sandler analysts said the target‑price cut reflects market worries that industry growth may be nearing its peak, prompting a downgrade of the expected price‑to‑earnings multiple.
Cisco’s stock hit an all‑time high in June and has risen 57% over the past 12 months, with revenue surging alongside the AI boom. The shares closed Tuesday at $106.44.
The company posted a strong fourth‑quarter earnings report last month, with revenue of $17.25 billion, beating LSEG’s estimate of $16.8 billion and exceeding market expectations.
In the most recent earnings call in August, Cisco presented a robust outlook for fiscal 2027, but tepid analyst reaction sent the stock lower afterward.

Cisco forecasts revenue growth of nearly 15%, though analysts expect the growth rate to fall back into single‑digit territory. Piper Sandler’s analysts argue that, given stronger market demand, Cisco’s guidance appears "conservative."

CEO Chuck Robbins said in an interview last month, "We are starting a new fiscal year. We are in a very strong market, but it is also a time when we will begin the new year with a slightly more cautious approach."
Hyperscale cloud providers generated about $4 billion of revenue for Cisco in fiscal 2026, and the company expects that figure to almost double to $7.5 billion in fiscal 2027.

items.title: 巴菲特卸任告別信留下「4字箴言」 點破投資市場不敗法則
items.title_en: Buffett Steps Down with a Farewell Letter Containing a “Four‑Word Maxim” that Reveals an Unbeatable Investment Rule
paras: 巴菲特上周五(18日)無預警發布了一封告別信，宣布即刻卸下波克夏(BRK.A-US) 董事長職位，結束長達61年的掌舵生涯。一如既往，這位「奧瑪哈先知」在信中展現其睿智哲理，其中包含了極具震撼力「四字投資箴言」。
以下是巴菲特的談話內容及其對投資人的啟示。
他在信中寫道：「日前，我和親友一同慶祝了我的 96 歲大壽，其中也包括我剛滿一歲的曾孫。現在他的行動速度可是比我快多了。」
隨後，巴菲特宣布卸下自1970年以來擔任的董事長職務，轉任榮譽董事長。他的兒子霍華．巴菲特（Howard Buffett）已在波克夏董事會任職33年，並接任董事長一職。
接著，巴菲特寫下四個發人深省的字，所有投資人都應將其視為一記警鐘：「時間終會勝出。」(Father Time always wins)
一方面，這句話指的是人終將老去；另一方面，這四個字也概括了巴菲特的投資理念。對投資人意味著什麼？「無論在人生或股市，時間終究都是最後贏家。」
巴菲特採取「買進並持有」策略，運用時間與複利，逐步將小額部位轉化為龐大的財富引擎。這項策略讓他成為億萬富豪，也使波克夏成長為市值兆美元級企業。
他也從不避諱公開宣揚這項理念。巴菲特1996年曾表示：「如果你不願意持有一檔股票10年，那就連持有10分鐘都不要考慮。」
另一件未曾改變的事，就是美國股市長期始終走高。過去50年來，標普500指數累計上漲2,100%；若計入股息再投資，總報酬率更達4,530%。難怪巴菲特的名言眾所周知：「我們最喜歡的持有期限是永遠。」
巴菲特並未以「時間終會勝出」作為告別信的結尾。他接著寫道：「然而，時間一直對我十分慷慨，讓我有機會看到波克夏發展到今天這個階段，也讓我對公司的未來比以往任何時候都更有信心。」
回顧標普 500 指數的歷史，很難不對股市的長期走勢抱持信心。即使歷經網路泡沫破裂與經濟大蕭條等重大崩盤，持續留在市場中的投資人，長期仍能獲得可觀報酬，平均表現遠遠勝過頻繁進出的短線客。
因此，即使巴菲特不再擔任波克夏董事長，他的建議與買進持有哲學，在時間的助力下，依然會是贏家。
paras_en: Last Friday (the 18th), Warren Buffett unexpectedly issued a farewell letter announcing that he is stepping down immediately from his role as chairman of Berkshire Hathaway (BRK.A‑US), ending a 61‑year tenure at the helm. As always, the “Oracle of Omaha” displayed his characteristic wisdom in the letter, which includes a striking four‑character investment maxim.
Below is the content of Buffett’s remarks and the insights they offer to investors.
He wrote in the letter: “Recently I celebrated my 96th birthday with family and friends, including my great‑great‑grandson who just turned one. He moves much faster than I do now.”

Buffett then announced that he is relinquishing the chairman position he has held since 1970, becoming honorary chairman. His son Howard Buffett, who has served on Berkshire’s board for 33 years, will assume the chairmanship.
Next, Buffett penned four thought‑provoking words that every investor should take as a warning: “Time always wins.”

On one hand, the phrase points to the fact that people inevitably age; on the other, those four words encapsulate Buffett’s investment philosophy. What does it mean for investors? “Whether in life or in the stock market, time is ultimately the final winner.”

Buffett has employed a “buy‑and‑hold” strategy, using time and compounding to gradually turn modest positions into a massive wealth engine. This approach made him a billionaire and grew Berkshire into a trillion‑dollar‑market‑cap enterprise.
He has never shied away from publicly championing this idea. In 1996, Buffett said, “If you’re not willing to hold a stock for ten years, don’t even think about holding it for ten minutes.”

Another unchanging fact is that the U.S. stock market has risen over the long term. Over the past 50 years the S&P 500 has risen 2,100%; with dividend reinvestment the total return reaches 4,530%. No wonder Buffett’s famous saying is, “Our favorite holding period is forever.”

Buffett did not end his farewell letter with “Time always wins.” He went on to write, “However, time has been very generous to me, giving me the chance to see Berkshire develop to where it is today, and it makes me more confident about the company’s future than ever before.”

Looking back at the history of the S&P 500, it is hard not to feel confident about the market’s long‑term trajectory. Even after major crashes such as the dot‑com bust and the Great Depression, investors who stayed in the market have, over the long run, earned substantial returns, far outperforming frequent short‑term traders.
Therefore, even though Buffett is no longer chairman of Berkshire, his advice and buy‑and‑hold philosophy, bolstered by the power of time, will continue to be a winning approach.

items.title: 高通一次推兩款新手機晶片 聚焦AI代理
items.title_en: Qualcomm Launches Two New Mobile Chips, Focusing on AI Agents
paras: 《Yahoo Finance》報導，高通(Qualcomm)(QCOM-US)周二(22日)在夏威夷茂宜島(Maui)舉行的年度Snapdragon峰會上，推出最新手機晶片。
高通表示，其Snapdragon 8 Elite Extreme Gen 6與Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 6，都是針對智慧代理AI所設計。
高通認為，讓AI代理與AI模型直接在裝置上運行，可以成為一種成本更低的替代方案，讓用戶不必付費透過雲端運行應用程式。
高通行動手機部門資深副總裁暨總經理Chris Patrick在聲明中表示，「今天是一個重要里程碑，我們一次推出兩款全新的旗艦行動平台，帶來即時、個人化且能適應需求的智慧代理AI體驗。」
他補充，「隨著智慧代理AI時代持續發展，我們的雙旗艦策略讓我們能夠突破行動裝置的可能性，同時將最新的AI創新帶給更廣泛的高階裝置。」
高通的手機晶片廣泛應用於全球高階Android裝置，包括小米、Motorola、中興通訊等品牌。
這家行動晶片巨頭正進行大規模轉型，希望降低對智慧型手機市場的依賴，並投入AI資料中心等成長領域。
高通在6月舉行的投資人日活動中，進一步說明了實現這項目標的計畫，公布一系列資料中心元件與伺服器產品，並宣布將2029會紀年度非手機業務營收預測幾乎提高一倍至400億美元。
高通最初開始降低對智慧型手機營收的依賴，是轉向邊緣裝置，包括筆記型電腦、智慧眼鏡以及自動駕駛車輛技術等產品。
不過，智慧型手機相關銷售仍持續推動高通營收。在7月公布的財報中，高通涵蓋智慧型手機、物聯網與汽車業務的CDMA Technologies部門營收，於該季貢獻85億美元，占高通總營收99億美元一大部分。其中，手機業務營收達到51億美元以上，汽車相關業務營收則達到15億美元。
高通股價周二上漲2.08%，至每股198.27美元。
paras_en: Yahoo Finance reported that Qualcomm (QCOM-US) on Tuesday the 22nd held its annual Snapdragon Summit on Maui, Hawaii, where it unveiled its latest mobile chips.
Qualcomm said its Snapdragon 8 Elite Extreme Gen 6 and Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 6 are both designed for smart‑agent AI.
Qualcomm believes that running AI agents and models directly on devices can be a lower‑cost alternative, letting users avoid paying for cloud‑based application execution.

Chris Patrick, senior vice president and general manager of Qualcomm’s mobile phone division, said in a statement, "Today is a major milestone – we are launching two brand‑new flagship mobile platforms that deliver real‑time, personalized, demand‑adaptive smart‑agent AI experiences."

He added, "As the era of smart‑agent AI continues to evolve, our dual‑flagship strategy enables us to push the boundaries of mobile devices while bringing the latest AI innovations to a broader range of premium devices."
Qualcomm’s mobile chips are widely used in high‑end Android devices worldwide, including brands such as Xiaomi, Motorola and ZTE.
The mobile‑chip giant is undergoing a large‑scale transformation, aiming to reduce its reliance on the smartphone market and invest in growth areas such as AI data centers.

At its investor day in June, Qualcomm further outlined its plan to achieve this goal, unveiling a suite of data‑center components and server products and announcing that its non‑phone revenue forecast for 2029 would almost double to $40 billion.
Qualcomm initially began reducing its dependence on smartphone revenue by shifting toward edge devices, including laptops, smart glasses and autonomous‑vehicle technologies.

Nevertheless, smartphone‑related sales continue to drive Qualcomm’s revenue. In its July earnings release, the CDMA Technologies segment covering smartphones, IoT and automotive contributed $8.5 billion that quarter, a large share of Qualcomm’s total $9.9 billion revenue, with mobile business revenue exceeding $5.1 billion and automotive‑related revenue reaching $1.5 billion.
Qualcomm’s stock rose 2.08% on Tuesday to $198.27 per share.

items.title: 油價成ECB關鍵指標 德國央行總裁：高能源價格恐迫使升息
items.title_en: Oil Prices Become Key Indicator for ECB, German Central Bank President Says High Energy Prices May Force Rate Hikes
paras: 油價正成為歐洲央行(ECB)制定利率政策時日益重要的觀察指標。德國央行(Bundesbank)總裁納格爾(Joachim Nagel)表示, 儘管油價並非ECB決策時唯一或最重要的依據, 但過去4年來其重要性已明顯提高, 如果能源價格持續處於高檔, ECB可能需要將貨幣政策推向溫和限制性區域。
納格爾周二(22日)在倫敦專業經濟學家協會(Society of Professional Economists)舉辦的活動上表示, 油價「絕對不是唯一的指標」, 但近4年來已成為「更相關的指標」。他指出, ECB管理委員會在制定利率決策時, 必須觀察油價並將其納入考量。
市場近期大幅提高對ECB進一步升息的押注, 主因中東戰事推升原油與天然氣價格, 加劇歐元區通膨風險。ECB今年夏季已兩度升息, 目前政策利率為2.5%, 市場則預期未來12個月可能再升息3至4次。
ECB面臨的另一項壓力來自能源價格已接近其較嚴重情境的假設。若油價與天然氣價格持續高企, 市場預期歐元區通膨率可能升至約4%, 約為ECB 2%通膨目標的兩倍。
不過, ECB總裁拉加德(Christine Lagarde)與副總裁武伊契奇(Boris Vujcic)近期均試圖降低市場對能源價格與升息之間直接連動的預期。兩人強調, ECB並不會單純因油價上升就機械式調高利率, 而是需要綜合評估通膨、經濟成長、家庭所得、消費及其他經濟數據。
武伊契奇日前表示, 市場近期對能源價格的敏感度明顯提高, 但ECB仍採逐次會議決策方式, 不會針對未來利率路徑提供明確指引。他指出, 油價對整體通膨的傳導速度較快, 主要透過燃料價格迅速反映在消費者物價上; 天然氣的影響則可能更持久, 不僅直接影響家庭能源帳單, 也會透過生產成本間接推升商品價格。
納格爾則表示, ECB目前2.5%的利率大致處於既不限制經濟成長, 也不刺激經濟活動的區域。但如果能源價格進一步上升, 他「不能排除」ECB必須把貨幣政策推向「溫和限制性」區域。
這番談話凸顯ECB目前面臨的政策兩難。一方面, 高油價與天然氣價格可能進一步推升通膨, 要求央行維持甚至提高利率; 另一方面, 能源成本上升也會侵蝕家庭實質所得、抑制消費, 並增加企業成本, 最終對經濟成長形成壓力。
武伊契奇先前也指出, 如果通膨在秋季持續處於高位並影響家庭收入與消費行為, 經濟成長可能因此受到抑制。因此, 單純觀察能源價格並不足以判斷未來利率走向, ECB仍須將更廣泛的經濟關係納入考量。
ECB首席經濟學家連恩(Philip Lane)則表示, 近期能源價格衝擊可能比原先預期持續更久, 地緣政治緊張升高進一步加劇油氣價格壓力。他預期, 第二波能源價格上漲將帶來更高且更持久的通膨, 但通膨率最終仍將逐步下降, 預計自2027年年中開始回到ECB目標附近。
油價近期的大幅波動也讓能源因素重新成為全球央行政策討論核心。中東局勢導致市場擔憂原油供應受阻, Brent與WTI原油價格一度大幅上漲, 進而推升市場對主要央行升息的預期。隨著近期中東原油流量改善以及荷姆茲海峽重新開放的可能性增加, 油價已從高點回落, 但能源價格是否能持續下降, 仍將成為ECB評估通膨與利率政策的重要變數。
納格爾的最新說法也顯示, ECB目前並未排除進一步升息的可能性, 但未來決策仍將取決於能源價格、通膨走勢以及經濟活動等多項數據。市場目前對未來數次升息的預期, 與ECB官員強調「逐次會議決策」的立場之間, 仍存在明顯落差。
paras_en: Oil prices are becoming an increasingly important indicator for the European Central Bank (ECB) when setting interest rate policy. Joachim Nagel, President of the German Bundesbank, said that although oil prices are not the sole or most important factor for ECB decisions, their importance has risen markedly over the past four years, and if energy prices remain high, the ECB may need to move monetary policy into a mildly restrictive zone.

Nagel said on Tuesday (22) at an event hosted by the Society of Professional Economists in London that oil prices "are absolutely not the only indicator," but have become a "more relevant indicator" over the past four years. He noted that the ECB Governing Council must monitor oil prices and incorporate them into its rate decisions.

Markets have recently sharply increased bets on further ECB rate hikes, largely due to Middle East conflicts driving up crude and natural gas prices and heightening inflation risks in the euro area. The ECB has raised rates twice this summer, bringing the policy rate to 2.5%, and markets now expect 3 to 4 more hikes over the next 12 months.

Another pressure on the ECB comes from energy prices approaching scenarios of greater severity. If oil and gas prices remain high, markets expect euro‑area inflation to rise to about 4%, roughly twice the ECB’s 2% target.

However, ECB President Christine Lagarde and Vice‑President Boris Vujcic have recently tried to reduce market expectations of a direct link between energy prices and rate hikes. They stressed that the ECB will not mechanically raise rates simply because oil prices rise, but will instead assess inflation, economic growth, household income, consumption and other data comprehensively.

Vujcic recently noted that market sensitivity to energy prices has risen sharply, but the ECB will still decide on a step‑by‑step basis and will not provide explicit guidance on future rate paths. He pointed out that oil prices transmit to overall inflation quickly, mainly through fuel prices reflected in consumer prices, while natural gas may have a more lasting impact, affecting household energy bills and indirectly pushing up product prices through production costs.

Nagel said the current 2.5% rate is roughly in a zone that neither restrains economic growth nor stimulates activity. But if energy prices rise further, he "cannot rule out" that the ECB must move monetary policy into a "mildly restrictive" area.

This discussion highlights the policy dilemma the ECB currently faces. On one hand, high oil and gas prices could further push inflation, requiring the central bank to maintain or raise rates; on the other hand, rising energy costs erode household real income, dampen consumption, and increase business costs, ultimately putting pressure on economic growth.

Vujcic also noted that if inflation remains high in the fall and affects household income and consumption behavior, economic growth could be suppressed. Therefore, simply observing energy prices is insufficient to determine future rate paths, and the ECB must incorporate broader economic relationships.

Philip Lane, ECB chief economist, said that recent energy price shocks may last longer than initially expected, with geopolitical tensions further amplifying oil and gas price pressures. He expects a second wave of energy price rises to bring higher and more persistent inflation, but inflation will ultimately ease gradually, returning near the ECB target around mid‑2027.

The recent sharp swings in oil prices have also brought energy factors back to the center of global central bank policy discussions. Middle East tensions have raised concerns about supply disruptions, with Brent and WTI crude prices spiking and boosting expectations of major central bank rate hikes. As Middle East crude flows improve and the Strait of Hormuz potentially reopens, oil prices have fallen from their highs, but whether energy prices will continue to decline remains a key variable for the ECB’s inflation and rate policy assessment.

Nagel’s latest remarks also show that the ECB has not ruled out further rate hikes, but future decisions will still depend on energy prices, inflation trends, and economic activity among other data. The market’s expectations for future hikes still diverge noticeably from the ECB officials’ emphasis on a "step‑by‑step" decision stance.

items.title: 馬斯克、黃仁勳與庫克赴宴見習近平 一文看懂他們對中國的訴求
items.title_en: Musk, Huang and Cook Attend Dinner with Xi: Understanding Their Demands on China
paras: 馬斯克每年有近 210 億美元的特斯拉營收來自中國；蘋果(AAPL-US) 上一年度在大中華區的營收超過 640 億美元；輝達(NVDA-US) 有價值數十億美元的晶片難以在中國銷售；花旗集團(C-US) 則仍在等待北京批准其早在 2021 年便申請設立的證券業務。
這些企業的代表周四(24日)預計將與中國國家主席習近平共進晚宴。
馬斯克、輝達執行長黃仁勳、花旗執行長范潔恩（Jane Fraser），以及蘋果執行董事長庫克（Tim Cook），都在白宮為習近平舉行國宴的受邀企業領袖之列。亞馬遜(AMZN-US) 創辦人貝佐斯、谷歌(GOOGL-US)執行長皮查伊、OpenAI 執行長奧特曼，以及及戴爾科技(DELL-US) 執行長戴爾預計也將出席。
這場晚宴正值習近平訪問美國之際，預料雙方將就貿易、稀土與人工智慧等議題展開會談。然而，對在座的企業高層而言，他們關切的問題更為具體。
美中貿易全國委員會會長史坦（Sean Stein）近日表示：「中國已成為這些企業公司基因與商業生態系的重要一環。」該委員會最新調查顯示，95% 受訪美國企業認為，中國對其全球競爭力至少具有一定程度的重要性。
特斯拉：中國營收近210億美元 市占卻持續下滑
很少有企業比特斯拉(TSLA-US) 更能說明這一點。
這家電動車大廠在2025 年在中國創造 209.6 億美元營收，約佔其全球總營收的22%。然而，市場競爭已日益白熱化：隨著本土競爭者急起直追，特斯拉在中國純電動車市場的市佔率，已從2020年的15%以上滑落至第二季的6.6%。
對馬斯克而言，維持可預測的競爭環境就相當重要。特斯拉上海工廠仍是關鍵生產與出口基地，而中國監管機關對特斯拉能否在這個美國以外最大市場自由營運，也具有重大影響力。
輝達：晶片有買家 美中監管成銷售雙重關卡
黃仁勳則面臨不同的難題：輝達在中國有渴望其晶片的客戶，但要促成這些交易卻變得益發繁複。
美國出口管制迫使輝達去年針對中國市場的 H20 處理器認列 45 億美元費用。華府此後已允許向部分中國客戶有限度出貨較新的 H200 晶片，但輝達表示，中國方面的限制使其無法售出許可範圍內的全部晶片。
在這項計畫下，H200 銷售額占輝達最近一季資料中心營收不到 1%。
這意味著黃仁勳必須同時取得美中兩國政府批准：華府須允許輝達出貨晶片，北京也須允許中國企業採購。
蘋果：中國既是重要市場 也是關鍵生產基地
相較之下，蘋果面臨的中國曝險則更加廣泛。
蘋果 2025 會計年度在大中華區的銷售額達 644 億美元，約占全球營收的 15%。儘管蘋果正將更多產能轉移至印度、越南等國，中國在其製造供應鏈中依舊盤根錯節。
北京當局不僅能影響蘋果的銷售品項，也能左右其生產基地。蘋果智慧功能（Apple Intelligence）直到今年7月才在中國取得登記核准，並由阿里巴巴與百度協助蘋果符合中國針對生成式AI的法規要求。
花旗：等待北京點頭 全資證券公司最快本月獲准
至於范潔恩，願望清單上的目標更加具體。
花旗正在等待中國核准其全資證券公司。該行已於 2021 年提出申請，最快可能在本月取得牌照。獲准後，花旗計劃將該部門人力擴增近一倍，達到約 100 人。
這份賓客名單也再次顯示，全球兩大經濟體要彼此脫鉤有多麼困難。
谷歌的皮查伊與OpenAI的奧特曼對中國銷售的直接依賴雖較低，但在整體的雙邊關係中仍牽動重大利益。
中美正展開 AI 競賽，中國開發商已迅速縮小與美國模型的差距，兩國政府同時也在研判，究竟應允許多少技術，尤其是先進運算能力跨越太平洋流通。
AI 預料將成為峰會討論重點之一。
這種依賴關係並非單向。中國政府預計也將帶著自身商業利益前往華府，而中國企業仍面臨美國關稅、投資限制及科技管制。
不過，這份美方賓客名單仍清楚反映，要拆解全球兩大經濟體之間的連結何其困難。
對即將與習近平共進晚宴的企業高層而言，中國既可能是客戶、生產基地、監管者，也可能是競爭對手，有時甚至同時扮演所有角色。
paras_en: Musk derives nearly $21 billion of Tesla’s annual revenue from China; Apple (AAPL-US) posted over $64 billion in revenue in Greater China last year; Nvidia (NVDA-US) has chip assets worth billions that are hard to sell in China; and Citigroup (C-US) is still awaiting Beijing’s approval of a securities business it applied for back in 2021.
The representatives of these firms are expected to dine with Chinese President Xi Jinping on Thursday (the 24th).

Musk, Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang, Citigroup CEO Jane Fraser, and Apple executive chairman Tim Cook are among the invited corporate leaders for the state dinner for Xi at the White House. Amazon (AMZN-US) founder Jeff Bezos, Google (GOOGL-US) CEO Sundar Pichai, OpenAI CEO Sam Altman, and Dell Technologies (DELL-US) CEO Michael Dell are also slated to attend.

The dinner coincides with Xi’s visit to the United States, and the two sides are expected to discuss trade, rare earths and artificial intelligence. Yet the executives present have more concrete concerns of their own.

Sean Stein, chair of the US‑China Trade National Committee, recently said: “China has become an essential part of these companies’ DNA and business ecosystems.” The committee’s latest survey shows 95 % of surveyed US firms view China as at least somewhat important to their global competitiveness.
Tesla: About $21 billion in China revenue but market share keeps falling
Few companies illustrate this better than Tesla (TSLA‑US).

The electric‑vehicle maker is projected to generate $20.96 billion in China in 2025, roughly 22 % of its total global revenue. However competition has intensified: as domestic rivals close the gap, Tesla’s share of China’s pure‑EV market has slipped from over 15 % in 2020 to 6.6 % in the second quarter.

For Musk, a predictable competitive environment is crucial. Tesla’s Shanghai plant remains a key production and export hub, and Chinese regulators’ stance on whether Tesla can operate freely in its largest market outside the US carries huge weight.
Nvidia: Chips have buyers, US‑China regulation creates a double hurdle
Jensen Huang faces a different dilemma: Nvidia has eager customers for its chips in China, but closing those deals has become increasingly complex.

U.S. export controls forced Nvidia to record a $4.5 billion expense last year for its H20 processor aimed at the Chinese market. Washington later allowed limited shipments of the newer H200 chip to some Chinese customers, but Nvidia says Chinese restrictions prevent it from selling the full range of chips it is permitted to ship.
Under this program, H200 sales account for less than 1 % of Nvidia’s most recent quarter’s data‑center revenue.
That means Huang must secure approvals from both governments: Washington must allow Nvidia to ship the chips, and Beijing must permit Chinese firms to buy them.
Apple: China is both a key market and a critical manufacturing base
By contrast, Apple’s exposure to China is broader.

Apple’s fiscal 2025 sales in Greater China are projected at $64.4 billion, about 15 % of its global revenue. Although Apple is shifting more capacity to India, Vietnam and other countries, China remains deeply embedded in its manufacturing supply chain.

Beijing authorities can influence not only Apple’s product sales but also its production sites. Apple Intelligence only received registration approval in China in July this year, with Alibaba and Baidu helping Apple meet Chinese regulations on generative AI.
Citigroup: Awaiting Beijing’s nod, a wholly‑owned securities firm could be approved this month
For Jane Fraser, the wish list is more concrete.

Citigroup is waiting for Chinese approval of its wholly‑owned securities subsidiary. The bank filed the application in 2021 and could obtain the licence as early as this month. Once approved, Citigroup plans to nearly double the unit’s staff to about 100 people.
The guest list again underscores how difficult it would be for the world’s two largest economies to decouple.
Google’s Pichai and OpenAI’s Altman have relatively low direct dependence on Chinese sales, yet they still touch significant interests in the broader bilateral relationship.

The US and China are locked in an AI race; Chinese developers have rapidly closed the gap with US models, and both governments are weighing how much technology—especially advanced computing power—should be allowed to flow across the Pacific.
AI is expected to be a major topic of discussion at the summit.

The dependence is not one‑way. The Chinese government is also expected to bring its own commercial interests to Washington, while Chinese firms continue to face US tariffs, investment limits and tech controls.
Nevertheless, the US side’s guest list makes clear how hard it is to untangle the connections between the two economic giants.
For the senior executives about to dine with Xi, China can be a customer, a manufacturing base, a regulator, a competitor, and sometimes all of these roles simultaneously.

items.title_en: <New York FX> Dollar Hovers Near 8-Week High as Fed Officials Emphasize Inflation Risks
paras: 美元周二(22日)上漲，延續上周聯準會(Fed)升息帶來的提振。歐元則在疲軟的消費者信心數據公布後走低。
紐約尾盤，追蹤美元兌六種主要貨幣的美元指數(DXY)上漲0.1%，報100.54，創7月29日以來最高。
聯邦公開市場委員會(FOMC)上周三一致投票決定，將聯邦資金利率從3.50%-3.75%上調至3.75%-4.00%。此外，聯準會更新的經濟預測摘要顯示，至少有12名FOMC成員預期今年還會再升息一次，而聯準會主席華許(Kevin Warsh)在決策後記者會上也明顯釋出鷹派訊號。
較高的利率環境通常有利於美元走強。自聯準會升息以來，美元已上漲近1%。
波士頓聯準銀行總裁柯林斯(Susan Collins)周二再次表示支持FOMC 的決定。她在社群媒體貼文中強調，偏高的價格壓力要求採取更具限制性的政策立場，以實現長期物價穩定。
她表示，近期經濟指標顯示，在成本持續偏高超過五年後，未來出現「通膨明顯高於2%」情境的可能性有所增加。
另外，里奇蒙聯準銀行總裁巴金(Tom Barkin)也支持FOMC的升息決定，並表示，目前通膨風險高於充分就業所面臨的風險。
油價成為市場焦點
本月一大主題，就是因能源推動的價格壓力而進行的央行升息，歐洲央行(ECB)與日本銀行(BoJ)也都在收緊貨幣政策。在此背景下，近期油價持續下跌，已引起外匯市場參與者關注。
原油基準價格已連續五個交易日下跌，原因包括市場對供應中斷的擔憂有所緩解，以及對中東外交取得進展的期待。交易員對沙烏地阿拉伯採取果斷措施感到振奮，以抵消一條重要管線關閉所造成的影響，該管線是在與伊朗支持的葉門武裝組織「青年運動」(Houthis)衝突擴大期間受損。
美國總統川普本周在聯合國大會期間，可能與伊朗代表團，包括外交部長及總統會面的可能性，也改善了市場情緒。川普周二在聯合國發表演講時表示，他認為華府與德黑蘭之間的協議將在即將於11月舉行的美國期中選舉後達成。
Macquarie全球外匯與利率策略師Thierry Wizman表示，「本周發生的事情可能成為決定原油價格中期走向的關鍵。因為美伊戰爭的關鍵參與者將從今天開始在紐約舉行會談。而這些會談所達成的協議與共識，可能決定戰爭是否持續並升級，或是否能找到退出衝突的途徑。」
他指出，「原油價格的走向仍會影響全球通膨，以及各國央行對此所採取的決策。我們已看到每家主要央行(包括美國聯準會)都提到能源價格或『地緣政治』是未來決策的一項驅動因素。這也是近期『鷹派』言論背後的關鍵原因。」
Wizman補充，「我們仍將較高的油價與美元兌主要貨幣走強聯繫在一起。這並不是因為高油價會導致聯準會升息，如果油價進一步上漲，所有央行都會轉鷹。原因在於，美國經濟成長與美元會透過貿易條件改善及實質所得效應，從高油價中受益。我們認為，美伊戰爭透過讓原油價格維持高檔，已成為今年支撐美元強勢的重要因素。」
歐元走弱 日元小幅走低
歐元兌美元下跌0.2%，至1.1448 美元。稍早公布數據顯示，歐元區9月消費者信心較8月轉弱，此前已連續四個月回升。
另一方面，日本銀行上周升息後，日元一度加速貶值，如今跌勢暫歇，匯價變化不大。美元兌日元略高於持平水準，報157.38。
由於日本正在放連續假期，亞洲交易部門成交量偏低。外匯配置機構警告，這種季節性交易低迷可能大幅放大市場波動，以及央行行動所帶來的影響。
《日本經濟新聞》報導，日銀已與外匯交易部門進行正式的「匯率詢價」，引發市場焦慮升溫。此程序是指央行官員致電商業銀行，詢問即時可執行的匯率報價。
儘管日元在日銀非一致決議升息25個基點後持續走弱，使借貸成本升至31年高點，但市場策略師指出，東京擁有龐大的政策火力。日本持有估計約1兆美元的外匯存底，為當局提供充足的流動性。
